body_en: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/how-trumps-newest-tariffs-could-impact-americans-and-the-economy

The Trump administration announced plans for a new round of tariffs on China, the European Union and 12 other major trading partners. China would face the highest rate with a new 20% tariff on most products. To discuss how this will impact Americans and the economy, Lisa Desjardins spoke with Gavin Bade of The Wall Street Journal.

The Trump administration announced plans for a new round of tariffs on China, the European Union, and 12 other major trading partners. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer argues, this is to protect manufacturing in the U.S.

We have a very consumption-driven economy, and we should be producing more of that here in the United States, but it makes it really hard when these other countries are producing or creating capacity that are not really justified by the economics of the situation.

And so we're proposing, on the one part, targeted tariffs that apply to a subset of goods from a given country at a tariff rate that maintains the deals we made with them. And on the other hand, we're also negotiating with these countries. We expect to have a broad, even a plurilateral negotiation to talk about excess capacity and how to resolve it.

China would face the highest rate with a new 20 percent tariff on most products. That would top existing levels, setting up a potential 40 percent tariff if negotiations fall apart. Other countries would face 10 to 20 percent in additional tariffs. Those could go into effect as soon as January.
For more on how this will impact Americans and the American economy, I'm joined by Gavin Bade of The Wall Street Journal, who first reported this plan.
Gavin, let's start with the big picture here. If these tariffs went into force in full, how significant would they be?
Gavin Bade, Trade and Economic Policy Reporter, The Wall Street Journal: I think they will be significant for consumers' pocketbooks.

This is really the Trump administration trying to rebuild its tariff wall after the Supreme Court back in February ruled many of its levies illegal. So the administration has reached for a different legal authority this time, one that is more tried and tested, and has put in place basically the level of tariffs that we saw at the beginning of this year before the Supreme Court decision.

You mentioned that Supreme Court decision. We heard from the Yale Economic Lab today, and they did say essentially, in their review, this will get us back to that level, as you put, and they think these tariffs would add another $400 for each American in general.
But my question to you is about that legal underlying rationale. How certain are we that these really have legal standing?
Well, they have certainly got a much better chance than the ones that went down at the Supreme Court.

That first round of tariffs under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, or IEEPA, that was the first time that law had ever been used for tariffs, and the Supreme Court really looked askance at the administration trying to rewrite the entire global trading system using this emergency law.

So they have turned to this section of the Trade Act of 1974. It's called Section 301, and it's to deal with unfair trading practices from other nations. So what they're saying here, and what you heard Jamieson Greer, the trade representative, say, is that they think that other countries are unnecessarily subsidizing their industries.

That's allowing company countries like China to flood the world market with products at a very low price. That's disadvantaging U.S. producers. And so they say that tariffs in this case are justified.
I know, when you mentioned Section 301, that sounds like we're getting into sort of minutiae, but actually that's something I think our viewers are going to hear more about as we head into January.

Something else about the timing, of course, is that the so-called tariff truce with China is supposed to end in January. It's hard to overlook that timing. When you look at the announcement today, do you think this is mostly a negotiating tactic about that deadline in January?

特朗普政府宣布了对中国、欧盟和其他12个主要贸易伙伴征收新一轮关税的计划。中国将面临最高税率，对大多数产品征收 20% 的新关税。为了讨论这将如何影响美国人和经济，丽莎·德贾丁斯与《华尔街日报》的加文·巴德进行了交谈。
我们有一个非常消费驱动的经济，我们应该在美国生产更多的消费，但是当其他国家生产或创造的产能与经济形势并不真正合理时，这就变得非常困难。
因此，我们一方面提议对来自特定国家的一部分商品征收有针对性的关税，其关税税率将维持我们与他们达成的交易。另一方面，我们也在与这些国家进行谈判。我们期望进行广泛的、甚至诸边的谈判来讨论产能过剩问题以及如何解决它。
中国将面临最高税率，对大多数产品征收 20% 的新关税。这将高于现有水平，如果谈判破裂，可能征收 40% 的关税。其他国家将面临 10% 至 20% 的额外关税。这些措施最早可能在一月份生效。
有关这将如何影响美国人和美国经济的更多信息，《华尔街日报》的加文·巴德 (Gavin Bade) 也加入了我的行列，他首先报道了这一计划。
加文，让我们从大局开始。如果这些关税全面生效，其影响有多大？
加文·巴德（Gavin Bade），《华尔街日报》贸易和经济政策记者：我认为它们对于消费者的钱包来说意义重大。
这实际上是特朗普政府在最高法院二月份裁定许多关税非法后试图重建其关税墙。因此，政府这次寻求了不同的法律权威，一个经过更多尝试和测试的法律权威，并且基本上已经实施了我们今年年初最高法院做出裁决之前看到的关税水平。
你提到了最高法院的判决。我们今天从耶鲁大学经济实验室获悉，他们在审查中确实表示，这将使我们回到你所说的水平，他们认为这些关税将为每个美国人额外增加 400 美元。
但我向你提出的问题是关于法律的基本原理。我们如何确定这些确实具有法律地位？
嗯，他们肯定比那些在最高法院被驳回的人有更好的机会。
《国际紧急经济权力法》（IEEPA）下的第一轮关税是该法律首次用于关税，最高法院对政府试图利用这项紧急法重写整个全球贸易体系持怀疑态度。
所以他们求助于 1974 年贸易法的这一部分。它被称为第 301 条，旨在处理来自其他国家的不公平贸易行为。所以他们在这里所说的，以及你听到贸易代表杰米森·格里尔所说的，是他们认为其他国家正在不必要地补贴他们的工业。
这使得像中国这样的企业国家能够以极低的价格向世界市场涌入产品。这对美国生产商不利。因此他们说，在这种情况下征收关税是合理的。
我知道，当您提到 301 条款时，听起来我们好像正在讨论一些细节，但实际上，我认为我们的观众在进入 1 月份时将会听到更多有关这一内容的内容。
当然，关于时间安排的另一件事是，与中国的所谓关税休战应该在一月份结束。很难忽视这个时机。当你看到今天的公告时，你是否认为这主要是针对一月份截止日期的谈判策略？

title_en: Ukraine says it downed a Russian jet-powered drone with a laser
title_zh: 乌克兰称其用激光击落了一架俄罗斯喷气式无人机
summary: Ukraine has used a laser weapon to shoot down a Russian jet-powered drone for the first time, a senior adviser to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says.
summary_zh: 总统泽连斯基的高级顾问表示，乌克兰首次使用激光武器击落一架俄罗斯喷气式无人机。
body_en: Ukraine says it has intercepted a Russian jet-powered drone with a laser for the first time - CBS News

Ukraine has used a laser weapon to shoot down a Russian jet-powered attack drone for the first time, a senior military adviser to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Wednesday, marking a potentially significant development in the country's effort to defend cities from Russia's daily aerial attacks.

The interception was carried out using the Blysk laser air defense system, which was developed and manufactured by Ukrainian defense technology firm Carmine Sky. Technology for laser air defense systems is being developed as part of the wider Private Air Defense program, Zelenskyy's adviser Serhii "Flash" Beskrestnov said in a statement .
About 100 companies across Ukraine have joined the government-backed private air defense initiative.

Russia started deploying jet-powered drones in its attacks on Ukraine earlier this year. The weapons travel faster, making them harder to intercept than the more common propeller-driven attack drones.

In June, Ukraine was only intercepting about 57% of the jet-powered drones , reflecting a significant vulnerability as Ukrainian forces had been shooting down about 90% of the conventional Russian attack drones.

Russia has increasingly used its Geran-4 and Geran-5 jet-powered drones in its attacks on Ukraine. Come Back Alive, a Ukrainian military nonprofit group, told CBS News in September that Russia was likely to produce some 1,200 Geran-4 and 800 Geran-5 drones during that month alone, and it projected those numbers would grow each month.
The laser interception reported by Beskrestnov this week gives some insight into Ukraine's mounting efforts to adapt both its offenses and defenses as Russia's weapons and tactics evolve.

Ukraine has pioneered battlefield drone technology, and it has started building partnerships to export that knowledge and its hardware around the world. In October, Ukrainian forces carried out a world-first aerial drone medical evacuation from the front line.
Ukraine started testing laser air defense systems over the summer. According to Beskrestnov, the Blysk system was used to protect critical infrastructure, though he declined to give more specifics.
He said a number of Ukrainian companies, including Carmine Sky, are working to develop laser technology, but he cautioned that "it is still too early to talk about serial production of the laser."
"Tests are underway, during which lasers protect critical infrastructure facilities," he said.

body_zh: 乌克兰表示首次用激光拦截了一架俄罗斯喷气式无人机 - 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻
乌克兰总统泽连斯基的高级军事顾问周三表示，乌克兰首次使用激光武器击落了一架俄罗斯喷气式攻击无人机，这标志着该国在保卫城市免受俄罗斯日常空袭的努力中可能取得重大进展。
此次拦截是使用Blysk激光防空系统进行的，该系统由乌克兰国防技术公司Carmine Sky开发和制造。泽连斯基的顾问谢尔希·“Flash”·别斯克雷斯诺夫在一份声明中表示，激光防空系统技术正在开发中，作为更广泛的私人防空计划的一部分。
乌克兰各地约 100 家公司已加入政府支持的私营防空计划。
俄罗斯今年早些时候开始在对乌克兰的袭击中部署喷气式无人机。这些武器的飞行速度更快，比更常见的螺旋桨驱动的攻击无人机更难拦截。
6 月份，乌克兰仅拦截了约 57% 的喷气式无人机，这反映出乌克兰军队已经击落了约 90% 的俄罗斯常规攻击无人机，因此存在重大漏洞。
俄罗斯在对乌克兰的攻击中越来越多地使用 Geran-4 和 Geran-5 喷气式无人机。乌克兰军事非营利组织 Come Back Alive 在 9 月份告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻，仅当月俄罗斯就可能生产约 1,200 架 Geran-4 和 800 架 Geran-5 无人机，并且预计这些数字每个月都会增加。
贝斯克列斯特诺夫本周报道的激光拦截事件让人们了解乌克兰随着俄罗斯武器和战术的发展而不断努力调整其进攻和防御。
乌克兰是战场无人机技术的先驱，并已开始建立合作伙伴关系，将这些知识及其硬件出口到世界各地。 10月，乌克兰军队从前线进行了世界首次空中无人机医疗后送。
乌克兰从今年夏天开始测试激光防空系统。 Beskrestnov 表示，Blysk 系统用于保护关键基础设施，但他拒绝透露更多细节。
他表示，包括 Carmine Sky 在内的多家乌克兰公司正在致力于开发激光技术，但他警告说，“现在谈论激光器的批量生产还为时过早。”
“测试正在进行中，测试期间激光器会保护关键的基础设施，”他说。

body_en: Beaches close as Los Angeles and La Jolla see all-time high tides and big waves batter landmark pier in Pacifica
Super El Niño weather brought record-breaking high tides up and down the California coast on Wednesday, sending seawater rushing into beachside communities and flooding roads and businesses.

As big waves battered the coast, the tip of a landmark pier in Pacifica, south of San Francisco, was slammed into the sea, local news outlets reported . The pier, which had once housed a favorite local cafe , had previously suffered structural damage and had been closed to the public, the San Francisco Chronicle reported , and collapsed after contact with ocean swells 12 times stronger than on an average November day.

Los Angeles and Santa Barbara tied or broke all-time high tide records on Wednesday, at 8.19 and 8.21ft, respectively, according to the National Weather Service (NWS). La Jolla, California, just north of San Diego, also set an all-time high tide record of 8.11ft (2.5 meters), according to the NWS, while preliminary data suggested that tides in Monterey, south of San Francisco, might also have set an all-time record at 8.03ft .
The city of Monterey closed multiple beaches to the public over safety concerns, with closures lasting until Friday. Beaches in Santa Cruz county were also closed.
“That sun may be out, but the beach and surf zone remain dangerous,” NWS San Francisco warned, citing waves around the San Francisco Bay area as high as 24ft.

“This is a preview of things to come,” California’s governor, Gavin Newsom, said in a San Francisco press conference about Wednesday’s flooding. “That’s why it’s so important that we not just situationally address and reflect on moments like this, but sustainably get under the hood and try to solve for some of these things.”

In Pacifica, giant waves and tide waters swept over beaches and piers, flooding coastal roads including Highway 1 near the famous local landmark Taco Bell Cantina, America’s poshest Taco Bell. (The iconic restaurant was unharmed by the tides, NBC Bay Area reported .)

“This El Niño is unprecedented with its strength,” the San Mateo county supervisor Ray Mueller told the Los Angeles Times . “For this to be happening when it is a beautiful day on the coast side today, in clear sunshine and no wind, is really significant.”

Multiple coastal homes in Sunset Beach, in Orange county, had flooded, the Los Angeles Times reported , but a local fire chief said the overall damage had been mitigated by how aggressively local homeowners had fortified their homes in advance.
Low-lying coastal roads around the Bay Area also saw flooding, including a stretch of road near the Golden Gate Bridge, which was temporarily closed, the Chronicle reported.
However, most of the state avoided the worst-case scenario – coastal flooding amplified by intense winter rainstorms.

“We’re past high tide, and San Francisco has made it through the worst of this round of king tides,” mayor Daniel Lurie said in a social media statement just after noon local time, saying officials were “only aware of minimal impacts across the city”.

Local officials had been preparing for weeks for the risk that flooding would disrupt travel during Thanksgiving week, one of the busiest times of the year. Experts warn that flooding risk will only worsen in the next two months.

Flooding risk at the San Francisco international airport, a major transit hub situated on low-lying coastal land, had been of particular concern. At least three airlines offered free trip changes to travelers whose journeys took them through San Francisco on Wednesday, the San Francisco Chronicle reported .
But the airport announced at noon that “We’re in the clear,” and said it was deactivating its emergency operations center after avoiding any impact from the high tides on Tuesday and Wednesday.

On the north coast, the NWS reported that Humboldt Bay saw its second highest tide on record, and advised residents to prepare for major coastal flooding in low lying areas. The county sheriff warned the public to stay away from beaches during the storm.

A local news outlet in Oregon shared a video on Tuesday that illustrated the risk of the west coast’s high-tide surf, showing a man and his dog almost getting swept away by unexpectedly high waves during the king tides in Cannon Beach, Oregon. Both man and dog escaped without injury, police told KVAL News .

The California governor’s office of emergency services deployed crews and equipment around the state to assist with storm response. In the Bay Area, crews could be seen preparing sandbags to help protect buildings from flooding.
body_zh: 洛杉矶和拉霍亚出现历史最高潮汐和大浪袭击帕西菲卡地标码头，海滩关闭
周三，超级厄尔尼诺天气在加州海岸带来破纪录的高潮，海水涌入海滨社区，淹没道路和企业。
据当地新闻媒体报道，当巨浪袭击海岸时，旧金山南部帕西菲卡的一个地标性码头的尖端被撞入海中。据《旧金山纪事报》报道，该码头曾经是当地一家最受欢迎的咖啡馆的所在地，此前曾遭受结构性损坏，并已对公众关闭，并在与比 11 月平均水平强 12 倍的海浪接触后倒塌。
根据国家气象局 (NWS) 的数据，洛杉矶和圣巴巴拉周三分别追平或打破了历史最高潮汐记录，分别为 8.19 英尺和 8.21 英尺。据国家气象局称，位于圣地亚哥北部的加利福尼亚州拉霍亚也创下了 8.11 英尺（2.5 米）的历史最高潮汐记录，而初步数据表明，旧金山南部蒙特利的潮汐也可能创下了 8.03 英尺的历史最高潮汐记录。
出于安全考虑，蒙特雷市对公众关闭了多个海滩，关闭持续到周五。圣克鲁斯县的海滩也被关闭。
旧金山 NWS 警告称，“太阳可能已经出来了，但海滩和冲浪区仍然很危险”，并援引了旧金山湾地区周围高达 24 英尺的海浪。
“这是未来事情的预演，”加州州长加文·纽瑟姆在旧金山关于周三洪水的新闻发布会上表示。 “这就是为什么如此重要的原因，我们不仅要根据具体情况处理和反思这样的时刻，还要持续地深入了解并尝试解决其中的一些问题。”
在帕西菲卡，巨浪和潮水席卷了海滩和码头，淹没了沿海道路，包括当地著名地标塔可贝尔酒吧（美国最豪华的塔可贝尔酒吧）附近的 1 号高速公路。 （据 NBC 湾区报道，这家标志性餐厅没有受到潮汐的影响。）
“这次厄尔尼诺现象的强度是前所未有的，”圣马特奥县主管雷·穆勒告诉《洛杉矶时报》。 “今天是海岸边美好的一天，阳光明媚，无风，发生这样的事情确实意义重大。”
据《洛杉矶时报》报道，奥兰治县日落海滩的多处沿海房屋被洪水淹没，但当地消防队长表示，当地房主提前积极加固房屋，总体损失减轻了。
据《纪事报》报道，湾区周围低洼的沿海道路也发生了洪水，其中包括金门大桥附近的一段道路，该道路暂时关闭。
然而，该州大部分地区避免了最坏的情况——冬季强烈暴雨加剧了沿海洪水。
当地时间中午过后，市长丹尼尔·卢里(Daniel Lurie)在社交媒体声明中表示：“涨潮已经过去，旧金山已经度过了这一轮大潮中最严重的时期。”他表示，官员们“只意识到整个城市受到的影响很小”。
当地官员几周来一直在为感恩节期间洪水扰乱出行的风险做好准备，感恩节是一年中最繁忙的时期之一。专家警告说，未来两个月洪水风险只会加剧。
位于低洼沿海地区的主要交通枢纽旧金山国际机场的洪水风险尤其令人担忧。据《旧金山纪事报》报道，至少有 3 家航空公司为周三途经旧金山的旅客提供免费行程变更服务。
但机场中午宣布“我们已经安全了”，并表示在避免周二和周三涨潮的影响后，将关闭紧急行动中心。
在北海岸，国家气象局报告说，洪堡湾出现了有记录以来的第二高潮，并建议居民为低洼地区的沿海大洪水做好准备。县治安官警告公众在风暴期间远离海滩。
俄勒冈州一家当地新闻媒体周二分享了一段视频，展示了西海岸涨潮冲浪的风险，视频显示，在俄勒冈州坎农海滩的大潮期间，一名男子和他的狗差点被意外的巨浪卷走。警方告诉 KVAL News，人和狗都逃脱了，没有受伤。
加州州长紧急服务办公室在全州各地部署了人员和设备，以协助应对风暴。在湾区，可以看到工作人员准备沙袋，以帮助保护建筑物免受洪水侵袭。

summary: A judge on Tuesday ordered Georgia's Fulton County to turn over a digital copy of ballots and other election records seized by the FBI earlier this year to the State Election Board, which had been trying for more than two years to obtain certain records from t

body_en: Kate Brumback, Associated Press Kate Brumback, Associated Press
https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/georgias-fulton-county-ordered-to-give-copy-of-2020-election-records-seized-by-fbi-to-state-board

ATLANTA (AP) — A judge on Tuesday ordered Georgia's Fulton County to turn over a digital copy of ballots and other election records seized by the FBI earlier this year to the State Election Board, which had been trying for more than two years to obtain certain records from the 2020 election in the state's most populous county.

Fulton County Superior Court Judge Kelly Lee Ellerbe ordered that the records be delivered to the state board by 5 p.m. Wednesday. She also put in place a protective order that limits who can see the unredacted records.
A Fulton County spokesperson declined to comment on a pending legal matter. The State Election Board did not immediately respond to an email seeking comment.

The FBI served a search warrant at the Fulton County elections hub on Jan. 28 seeking records related to the 2020 election, leaving with hundreds of boxes containing ballots and other records. The county unsuccessfully sought to have a judge order the return of the records, but the federal government did provide the county with what it said was a digital copy of the records that were taken.

The overwhelmingly Democratic county, which includes most of the city of Atlanta, has been a target of President Donald Trump and his allies since he narrowly lost the presidential election in Georgia to Democrat Joe Biden in 2020. Trump has consistently insisted without evidence that widespread voter fraud in the county cost him victory in the state. Multiple courts and state and federal officials have found no evidence of fraud that would have altered the outcome.

A statement from an FBI agent supporting the search warrant used to take the records said the agency was examining possible "deficiencies or defects" in Fulton County's 2020 vote count. More than six years after that election and 10 months after the records seizure, no charges have been filed.

The FBI in July instructed field offices across the country to dedicate more than 200 staffers to its investigation of the 2020 election in Fulton County, describing it as a "priority investigation," and The New York Times reported that the FBI and federal prosecutors last week interviewed the man who served as the county's election director in 2020.

A Trump-aligned majority on the State Election Board has repeatedly sought to reopen a case alleging wrongdoing by Fulton County during the 2020 election. The board in November 2024 served subpoenas on the county seeking records related to the 2020 election. County election officials asked a judge to quash the subpoenas.

Fulton County Superior Court Judge Robert McBurney in December 2025 declined to quash the subpoenas, finding that the State Election Board's inquiries "fell squarely within the SEB's authority." He ruled that the state board would have to bear the costs of producing the records it was seeking and a hearing on that matter was pending when the FBI seized the county's records. As a result, McBurney put the case on hold.

Ellerbe, who took over the case this year, held a hearing on the matter in October before issuing her order Tuesday. Her protective order says the State Election Board can use the records for its investigations but says the records cannot be disclosed to anyone other than people identified in the order, which includes the board members and staff, as well as experts they may consult.

亚特兰大（美联社）——周二，一名法官命令佐治亚州富尔顿县将联邦调查局今年早些时候扣押的选票和其他选举记录的数字副本移交给州选举委员会，该委员会两年多来一直试图获取该州人口最多的县 2020 年选举的某些记录。
富尔顿县高等法院法官 Kelly Lee Ellerbe 下令在下午 5 点之前将记录交付给州委员会。周三。她还制定了一项保护令，限制谁可以看到未经编辑的记录。
富尔顿县发言人拒绝就悬而未决的法律问题发表评论。州选举委员会没有立即回复寻求置评的电子邮件。
1 月 28 日，联邦调查局 (FBI) 在富尔顿县选举中心发出搜查令，寻找与 2020 年选举相关的记录，留下数百个装有选票和其他记录的盒子。该县未能成功要求法官下令归还记录，但联邦政府确实向该县提供了据称所获取记录的数字副本。

自从唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 在 2020 年佐治亚州总统选举中以微弱优势输给民主党人乔·拜登 (Joe Biden) 以来，这个包括亚特兰大市大部分地区的民主党县一直是唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 总统及其盟友的攻击目标。特朗普在没有证据的情况下一直坚持认为，该县普遍存在的选民欺诈行为导致他在该州获胜。多个法院以及州和联邦官员没有发现任何会改变结果的欺诈证据。
一名联邦调查局特工在一份支持用于获取记录的搜查令的声明中表示，该机构正在检查富尔顿县 2020 年计票中可能存在的“缺陷或缺陷”。那次选举六年多、记录被扣押十个月后，尚未提出任何指控。
联邦调查局 (FBI) 7 月指示全国各地的办事处派出 200 多名工作人员专门调查富尔顿县 2020 年选举，并将其描述为“优先调查”。《纽约时报》报道称，联邦调查局和联邦检察官上周约谈了担任该县 2020 年选举主任的男子。
州选举委员会中与特朗普结盟的多数派一再寻求重新审理指控富尔顿县在 2020 年选举期间不当行为的案件。该委员会于 2024 年 11 月向该县发出传票，寻求与 2020 年选举相关的记录。县选举官员要求法官撤销传票。
富尔顿县高等法院法官罗伯特·麦克伯尼 (Robert McBurney) 于 2025 年 12 月拒绝撤销传票，认为州选举委员会的调查“完全属于 SEB 的职权范围”。他裁定，州委员会必须承担制作其所寻求的记录的费用，并且当联邦调查局扣押该县的记录时，有关此事的听证会正在等待中。结果，麦克伯尼搁置了此案。
今年接手此案的埃勒贝于 10 月份就此事举行了听证会，然后于周二发布了命令。她的保护令称，州选举委员会可以使用这些记录进行调查，但表示这些记录不能透露给命令中指定的人以外的任何人，其中包括委员会成员和工作人员，以及他们可能咨询的专家。

title_en: Fuel tanker explosion kills 31 on Egyptian highway
title_zh: 埃及高速公路油罐车爆炸造成31人死亡
summary: A massive fire killed 31 people in Egypt after a speeding driver allegedly crashed into a fuel tanker truck.
summary_zh: 埃及一名超速司机涉嫌撞上一辆油罐车，引发大火，造成 31 人死亡。
body_en: Egypt tanker explosion kills 31 people as driver crashes into fuel truck in fiery highway crash - CBS News
Cairo — A massive fire on an Egyptian highway killed 31 people and injured 21 others after a car slammed into a fuel tanker truck at high speed, Egypt's Public Prosecution office said Thursday.
The driver has been arrested, according to the statement. At least 27 vehicles, including cars and motorcycles, were destroyed in the fire.
The prosecutor said the suspect admitted causing the accident while driving around 70 miles per hour on a major highway in the Al-Warraq district of Giza, which is part of the Greater Cairo area.

The driver said he was changing lanes and overtaking vehicles when the front-left side of his car struck the rear-right side of the tanker, according to the prosecutor's statement, "causing the steering wheel to slip from his hands and his car to veer off course."
When the car hit the truck, one of the truck's tires exploded, causing it to overturn and slam into a concrete barrier.
Gasoline then leaked from the tanker and caught on fire. Images of the blaze on social media showed multiple vehicles on fire as flames and smoke billowed into the night sky.
The prosecutor said the suspect was being questioned to establish the circumstances of the accident and assess any criminal responsibility.
"It was a huge fire, the cars got stuck together because of the fire," Ahmed Sameer, who was stuck in traffic behind the accident, told The Associated Press. "It was a shocking scene."
Sameer told the AP he saw at least eight bodies being removed from charred vehicles.
Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah el-Sisi expressed his condolences to the victims of the crash.
In a statement on X , Egypt's health ministry said 39 ambulances took part in the rescue operation.

While fatal traffic accidents are common in Egypt, the sheer scale of the incident has prompted calls for greater accountability. Last year, nearly 6,000 people died in road traffic accidents across Egypt, according to official data.

body_zh: 埃及油罐车发生爆炸，司机撞上加油车，造成 31 人死亡 - 哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 新闻
开罗——埃及检察机关周四表示，一辆汽车高速撞上一辆油罐车，埃及高速公路发生大火，造成 31 人死亡、21 人受伤。
声明称，司机已被捕。火灾中至少有27辆汽车被毁，其中包括汽车和摩托车。
检察官表示，嫌疑人承认在吉萨瓦拉克区（大开罗地区的一部分）的一条主要高速公路上以每小时约 70 英里的速度行驶时造成了这起事故。
根据检察官的声明，司机表示，当时他正在变道并超车，他的汽车左前侧撞上了油罐车的右后侧，“导致方向盘从他手中滑落，汽车偏离路线。”
当汽车撞上卡车时，卡车的一个轮胎爆炸，导致卡车翻倒并撞上混凝土护栏。
随后汽油从油罐车泄漏并着火。社交媒体上的火灾图像显示，多辆车辆起火，火焰和浓烟冲上夜空。
检察官表示，正在对嫌疑人进行讯问，以查明事故情况并评估刑事责任。
事故发生后堵在路上的艾哈迈德·萨米尔告诉美联社：“这是一场巨大的火灾，汽车因火灾而粘在一起。” “这是一个令人震惊的场景。”
萨米尔告诉美联社，他看到至少八具尸体从烧焦的车辆中被移走。
埃及总统阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西向坠机事件的遇难者表示哀悼。
埃及卫生部在X日的一份声明中表示，有39辆救护车参与了救援行动。
虽然致命的交通事故在埃及很常见，但该事件的规模之大促使人们呼吁加大问责力度。根据官方数据，去年埃及各地有近 6000 人死于道路交通事故。

title_en: What's open and closed today on Thanksgiving Day 2026?
title_zh: 2026 年感恩节今天有哪些营业和休息场所？
summary: A handful of grocery stores will welcome customers on Thanksgiving this year, while most retailers will be closed. Here's what to know.

body_en: What's open and closed today on Thanksgiving Day 2026? Hours for stores, restaurants, banks and more - CBS News

Thanksgiving is here, giving Americans a chance to gather around the table, overdose on rich foods and renew family squabbles. Need to make a quick run to the store for some last-minute supplies? We got you.
Read on for a snapshot of which stores are open and closed this Thanksgiving, as well as on Black Friday.
Is CVS open on Thanksgiving? CVS Pharmacy locations will be open on Thursday, although some stores and pharmacies may have reduced hours, according to a company spokesperson.
Is Walgreens open on Thanksgiving and Black Friday? Walgreens stores and pharmacies will be open during regular business hours on Thanksgiving.
Is Target open on Thanksgiving? All Target stores will be closed on Thanksgiving, according to the company's website .
Is Walmart open on Thanksgiving? Walmart is closed on Thanksgiving, a spokesperson told CBS News.
Is Costco open on Thanksgiving? Costco is closed on Thanksgiving, as noted on the holiday closure page .
Are fast-food chains open on Thanksgiving? Retailers recommend checking local hours in advance, as they may vary by location.
Taco Bell — most locations are closed, according to the company's website . A spokesperson encouraged guests to check their local restaurant for holiday hours.
Stop & Shop — locations in Connecticut, New Jersey and New York are open until 3 p.m.; Massachusetts and Rhode Island locations are closed per state law.
Whole Foods — most stores are open from 7 a.m. to 1 p.m., with a few exceptions.
Are retailers open on Thanksgiving? Most r etail stores are closed. Dollar General is a notable exception.

Is the stock market open on Thanksgiving? The stock market is closed on Thanksgiving, according to the holiday calendars for Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange. Markets will be open on Friday but will close early at 1 p.m.
Are banks open on Thanksgiving? Most major banks are closed on Thursday, while Thanksgiving is also a Federal Reserve holiday.
Is the post office open on Thanksgiving? Post office locations will be closed on Thursday to observe the holiday. Regular mail delivery will resume Friday, Nov. 27, according to the USPS .
Some stores are extending their hours on Black Friday, with many consumers planning to kick off their holiday shopping. See below for a sampling of retailers' hours on Friday.
CVS — open regular hours, although some pharmacies may have reduced hours
HomeGoods — stores open from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
Homesense — stores open from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.

title_en: New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade postponed due to weather
title_zh: 纽约梅西百货感恩节大游行因天气原因推迟
summary: Forecasters say high winds on Thursday may spoil the annual march of huge balloons and have moved the parade to Saturday New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade has been postponed due to excessively windy weather and will now be held on Saturday. Foreca
summary_zh: 预报员表示，周四的大风可能会破坏每年一度的巨型气球游行，并将游行移至周六纽约市的梅西百货感恩节
body_en: Forecasters say high winds on Thursday may spoil the annual march of huge balloons and have moved the parade to Saturday
New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade has been postponed due to excessively windy weather and will now be held on Saturday.

Forecasters say an impending storm on Thursday may spoil the street party, which is marked by a march of huge balloons. AccuWeather is forecasting winds of 12 to 25 mph (19 to 40 km/h) and rain later on Thursday.
Under guidelines, large balloons must stay grounded if sustained winds exceed 23 mph (37 km/h) or gusts exceed 34 mph (55 km/h). The parade balloons have been grounded only once previously, in 1971.
NBC quoted Macy’s as saying: “The safety of our participants and spectators is our priority.”
Macy’s added: “Thank you to the thousands of volunteers, performers and partners who create the magic millions enjoy each year. We look forward to celebrating together on Saturday.”

This year the parade will include a tribute to Dolly Parton led by Megan Hilty, and special appearances by Melissa Joan Hart, Jack McBrayer, Janet McTeer and Holly Robinson Peete, all leading the way for Santa Claus. Nine Broadway shows will be featured as part of a 10-minute medley, replacing the traditional sprinkling of full show numbers.

The Macy’s parade began more than a century ago in 1924 as a way of creating buzz for the giant department store’s holiday windows at Macy’s Herald Square flagship store in Manhattan. Macy’s borrowed animals from the Central Park Zoo for the first parades but in 1927 ended that practice after children were getting scared.

The animals were then replaced with air-filled balloons and, a year later, balloons that could be filled with helium – a now familiar sight for people around the world from countless Hollywood movies set in New York City.

The parades have been fully cancelled previously only in 1942, 1943 and 1944 because the valuable materials needed to create the huge balloons were diverted for the the second world war effort against Germany and Japan.
body_zh: 预报员表示，周四的大风可能会破坏每年一度的巨型气球游行，并将游行移至周六
纽约市梅西百货感恩节游行因大风天气而推迟，现将于周六举行。
预报员表示，周四即将到来的暴风雨可能会破坏以巨大气球游行为标志的街头派对。 AccuWeather 预计周四晚些时候将有 12 至 25 英里/小时（19 至 40 公里/小时）的风速和降雨。
根据指导方针，如果持续风速超过 23 英里/小时（37 公里/小时）或阵风超过 34 英里/小时（55 公里/小时），大型气球必须保持接地。游行气球此前仅在 1971 年被接地过一次。
NBC援引梅西百货的话说：“参与者和观众的安全是我们的首要任务。”
梅西百货补充道：“感谢成千上万的志愿者、表演者和合作伙伴，他们每年创造了数百万人享受的魔法。我们期待着周六一起庆祝。”

今年的游行将包括由梅根·希尔蒂 (Megan Hilty) 领导的向多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 致敬的活动，以及梅丽莎·琼·哈特 (Melissa Joan Hart)、杰克·麦克布瑞尔 (Jack McBrayer)、珍妮特·麦克蒂尔 (Janet McTeer) 和霍莉·罗宾逊·皮特 (Holly Robinson Peete) 的特别亮相，他们都为圣诞老人带路。九场百老汇演出将作为 10 分钟混合表演的一部分，取代传统的散播完整演出的方式。
梅西百货游行始于一个多世纪前的 1924 年，目的是为曼哈顿梅西百货先驱广场旗舰店的大型百货商店假日橱窗制造热闹。梅西百货从中央公园动物园借来了动物进行首次游行，但在 1927 年孩子们感到害怕后终止了这种做法。
然后，这些动物被充气气球所取代，一年后，又被充满氦气的气球所取代——这是世界各地人们在无数以纽约为背景的好莱坞电影中熟悉的景象。
此前，仅在 1942 年、1943 年和 1944 年，阅兵式才被完全取消，因为制造巨型气球所需的宝贵材料被转用于第二次世界大战中对抗德国和日本的行动。

title_en: 'Memories of a Good Meal': How food made a difference during WWII
title_zh: “一顿美餐的回忆”：二战期间食物如何发挥作用
summary: New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.
summary_zh: 新奥尔良厨师阿隆·沙亚 (Alon Shaya) 的新烹饪书讲述了二战期间以食物为中心的坚韧故事。
body_en: 'Memories of a Good Meal': How food mattered in WWII : NPR
'Memories of a Good Meal': How food mattered in WWII New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.

In a composite of three images, June Hersh (left), Steven Fenves (center) and Alon Shaya (right) flip through a book of recipes. The Fenves family's cook salvaged the book when family members were captured by the Nazis. Denny Culbert; June Hersh and Alon Shaya hide caption
NEW ORLEANS — Chef Alon Shaya believes there's power in a meal.

"It's always been the way that I can start a conversation, build a relationship, disagree about things, but still be able to come together and break bread," Shaya, of the acclaimed Crescent City restaurant Saba, said one recent afternoon. "When you share a meal with someone, a lot of those barriers get broken down."

The Israeli American chef also believes food can be a source of inspiration even in the darkest of times. A few years ago, he spearheaded the Rescued Recipes initiative at the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, and that got him digging deeper into the role that food played during World War II.
Now, he's collected those stories and the dishes they inspired in a new historical cookbook, Memories of a Good Meal: Recipes of Resilience Inspired by Stories of World War II Survival .
Shaya hopes home cooks use the recipes to inspire dinner table conversations about the deeper stories behind them.
"I want people to gather and cook and eat and put their phones down, and share a meal and recount these miraculous stories of survival, resilience and heroism," he told NPR.

Stories like that of Roddie Edmonds, a U.S. Army master sergeant, whose unit was captured in the Battle of the Bulge and imprisoned in a German POW camp. (Edmonds posthumously won the Congressional Medal of Honor earlier this year for his refusal to turn in his Jewish troops to be sent to concentration camps.)

One of the ways Edmonds and his fellow prisoners distracted themselves from the horror of the camp was to talk about the foods that reminded them of home, be it Sunday spaghetti sauce, hot cakes or cherry pie.

"They're eating up this idea that they were going to go home," Shaya said. "They were going to be free, and they were going to be able to sit around and dig into that filet mignon with creamy mushroom sauce."

The servicemen sketched out detailed plans for a dreamed-of restaurant called the Jolly Chef. There, they would serve all those yearned-for dishes, including candied yams with pecans and whipped marshmallow — one of the recipes in the new cookbook.

Another chapter highlights Polish partisan fighters who lived in underground bunkers and sabotaged the Nazis by derailing trains and blowing up ammunition plants. In a nod to the fire that ensued, a recipe from their chapter also includes smashed potatoes flambéed in vodka.

"Vodka was a form of currency for them," Shaya said. "They would use it to barter. They would use it to celebrate. And so each moment of that recipe helps to really tell the story of what they were going through."

The book has stories from around the world – Hungarian Jews whose non-Jewish cook salvaged the treasured family cookbook as they were being sent to Auschwitz; a French village that took in Jewish children and hid them from the Nazis; Navajo code breakers who changed the course of the war; and Japanese Americans, convicted of no crimes, who were incarcerated in military-style camps in the U.S.

June Hersh , a food historian and writer who worked with Shaya on the cookbook, said remembering and talking about favorite recipes was a form of resistance – turning a tragic situation into something triumphant.

"You can put me in a uniform, you can make me do hard labor, you can shave my head, you can starve me if you want, but I'm not going to let go of my food memory," she said. "It's something you can't take away from me."
body_zh: “一顿美餐的回忆”：食物在二战中的重要性：NPR
“一顿美餐的回忆”：食物在二战中的重要性 新奥尔良厨师 Alon Shaya 的新食谱分享了二战期间以食物为中心的恢复故事。
在三幅图像的合成中，琼·赫什（左）、史蒂文·芬维斯（中）和阿隆·沙亚（右）翻阅一本食谱书。当芬维斯家族的成员被纳粹俘虏时，芬维斯家族的厨师抢救了这本书。丹尼·卡尔伯特；琼·赫什和阿隆·沙亚隐藏标题栏
新奥尔良——主厨阿隆·沙亚 (Alon Shaya) 相信一顿饭的力量。
最近的一个下午，在著名的新月城餐厅萨巴工作的沙亚说：“这一直是我开始对话、建立关系、对事情有不同意见，但仍然能够聚在一起吃饭的方式。” “当你与某人分享一顿饭时，很多障碍就会被打破。”
这位以色列裔美国厨师还相信，即使在最黑暗的时期，食物也可以成为灵感的源泉。几年前，他在美国大屠杀纪念博物馆发起了“拯救食谱”倡议，这让他更深入地研究了食物在二战期间所扮演的角色。
现在，他将这些故事和它们启发的菜肴收集在一本新的历史烹饪书中，《美餐的回忆：受二战生存故事启发的韧性食谱》。
沙亚希望家庭厨师能够利用这些食谱激发餐桌上的对话，探讨其背后更深层的故事。
他告诉美国国家公共广播电台：“我希望人们聚集在一起，做饭、吃饭，放下手机，共享一顿饭，讲述这些关于生存、恢复力和英雄主义的奇迹故事。”
诸如美国陆军军士长罗迪·埃德蒙兹的故事，他的部队在突出部战役中被俘，并被囚禁在德国战俘营中。 （埃德蒙兹今年早些时候因拒绝交出将其犹太军队送往集中营而被追授国会荣誉勋章。）
埃德蒙兹和他的狱友们分散注意力的方法之一是谈论那些让他们想起家乡的食物，无论是周日意大利面酱、热蛋糕还是樱桃派。
沙亚说：“他们正在接受要回家的想法。” “他们将获得自由，他们将能够坐下来吃带有奶油蘑菇酱的菲力牛排。”
军人们为一家名为“Jolly Chef”的梦想餐厅制定了详细的计划。在那里，他们会提供所有人们渴望的菜肴，包括山核桃蜜饯山药和搅打棉花糖——这是新食谱中的食谱之一。
另一章重点介绍了居住在地下掩体中的波兰游击战士，他们通过使火车脱轨和炸毁弹药厂来破坏纳粹。为了向随后发生的火灾致敬，他们的章节中的食谱还包括用伏特加燃烧的土豆泥。
“伏特加对他们来说是一种货币，”沙亚说。 “他们会用它来交换。他们会用它来庆祝。所以这个食谱的每一刻都有助于真正讲述他们正在经历的故事。”
这本书讲述了来自世界各地的故事——匈牙利犹太人，他们的非犹太厨师在被送往奥斯维辛集中营时抢救了这本珍贵的家庭食谱；一个法国村庄收留了犹太儿童并将他们藏起来以躲避纳粹分子的袭击；改变战争进程的纳瓦霍密码破译者；以及没有被定罪的日裔美国人，他们被关押在美国的军事式营地中。
与沙亚一起编写这本食谱的食品历史学家和作家琼·赫什 (June Hersh) 表示，记住和谈论最喜欢的食谱是一种抵抗形式，可以将悲惨的局面变成胜利的局面。
“你可以让我穿上制服，你可以让我做苦役，你可以给我剃光头，如果你愿意，你可以让我挨饿，但我不会放弃我的食物记忆，”她说。 “这是你无法从我身边夺走的东西。”

title_en: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
title_zh: 在阿尔伯克基的 Indian Pueblo Kitchen，美洲原住民菜肴是主菜
summary: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.
summary_zh: 在新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的博物馆里，餐厅和展览一样吸引人，提供绿色智利炖菜和甜脆饼等菜肴
body_en: Indian Pueblo Kitchen serves Native American food on Route 66 : NPR

Indian Pueblo Kitchen serves Native American food on Route 66 At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

Dishes from Indian Pueblo Kitchen in Albuquerque, N.M., include (clockwise from left) an Indian taco on fry bread, a bowl of atole blue corn porridge with fresh berries, a plate of Pueblo pies with biscochitos and a bowl of red chile beef bone posole. Adria Malcolm for NPR hide caption
There are plenty of kitschy diners and barbecue joints along Route 66, but just a couple of miles off the highway in Albuquerque, N.M., Native American dishes are the star at Indian Pueblo Kitchen .
Late on a weekday morning, the restaurant was already starting to fill up. Most of the tables were taken up by locals, like Merlyn Liberty and Rolf Pendall.
The Indian Pueblo Kitchen restaurant is attached to the Indian Pueblo Cultural Center, which was founded by the 19 Pueblo tribes of New Mexico in 1976. Adria Malcolm for NPR hide caption
"I started with breakfast dessert. The blue corn waffles. And now I'm finishing up my sweetheart's plate of enchiladas and pinto beans," Pendall said.
The restaurant is attached to the Indian Pueblo Cultural Center , a museum and cultural center founded in 1976 by the 19 Pueblo tribes of New Mexico.

The center sits on land where the Albuquerque Indian School operated. Open from 1881 to the early 1980s, it was one of the hundreds of federally funded boarding schools designed to strip Native American children of their family bonds, languages, culture and spiritual practices.
The Indian Pueblo Cultural Center's president and CEO, Monique Fragua, said visitors can start in the museum's galleries and then visit the restaurant to experience Pueblo culture and hospitality.

The Indian Pueblo Cultural Center's president and CEO, Monique Fragua, says visitors can experience Pueblo culture through exhibits at the museum and food in the restaurant. Adria Malcolm for NPR hide caption
"Whether that's through our exhibits, or our food, or in our gift shop, we can celebrate the art of our Pueblo communities," Fragua said.
Museum cafés are not a typical destination for foodies, but this one is.

The menu is all Native American and Southwestern-inspired. Dishes include blue corn enchiladas that you can get "Christmas style," one with red chile sauce and the other with green chile sauce. There's a chile posole with beef short ribs served on the bone, as well as Indian tacos on homemade fry bread. Then there's a dish that's really popular on social media : pickles marinated in cherry Kool-Aid and then deep-fried and served with a green chile ranch sauce.
Patrons dine inside Indian Pueblo Kitchen, which features Native American and Southwestern-inspired menu items. Adria Malcolm for NPR hide caption

Rita Toledo, from Jemez Pueblo, is Indian Pueblo Kitchen's star baker. One of her specialties is biscochitos — fragrant shortbread cookies spiced with anise and rolled in cinnamon sugar that are New Mexico's state cookie. Toledo has made some twists on the traditional biscochito, like making a chile pepper version that has just a little kick at the end with a nice balance of sweet and heat.

Indian Pueblo Kitchen's version of biscochitos is so popular that the restaurant also sells them at its café inside Albuquerque's airport. Toledo turns out at least 48 dozen biscochitos each week just for the airport location.
Toledo said that she has been baking all her life and that her favorite part of her work is rolling out dough.
body_zh: 印度普韦布洛厨房 (Indian Pueblo Kitchen) 在 66 号公路上供应美洲原住民美食：NPR
Indian Pueblo Kitchen 在 66 号公路上供应美洲原住民美食。这家餐厅位于新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的一座博物馆中，与展览一样吸引人，提供绿智利炖菜和茴香和肉桂调味的甜脆饼等菜肴。
新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的印第安普韦布洛厨房 (Indian Pueblo Kitchen) 的菜肴包括（从左顺时针方向）炸面包上的印度炸玉米饼、一碗配有新鲜浆果的 atole 蓝玉米粥、一盘普韦布洛馅饼和 biscochitos 以及一碗红智利牛骨波索莱。 NPR 的阿德里亚·马尔科姆隐藏标题栏
66 号公路沿线有很多俗气的餐馆和烧烤店，但在距新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基高速公路仅几英里的地方，印第安普韦布洛厨房 (Indian Pueblo Kitchen) 的美洲原住民菜肴才是明星。
工作日的上午晚些时候，餐厅已经开始挤满了人。大多数桌子都被当地人占据了，比如 Merlyn Liberty 和 Rolf Pendall。
Indian Pueblo Kitchen 餐厅隶属于印第安普韦布洛文化中心，该文化中心由新墨西哥州的 19 个普韦布洛部落于 1976 年创立。Adria Malcolm for NPR 隐藏标题栏
“我从早餐甜点开始。蓝色玉米华夫饼。现在我正在吃完我爱人的一盘玉米卷饼和斑豆，”彭德尔说。
该餐厅隶属于印第安普韦布洛文化中心，这是一个由新墨西哥州 19 个普韦布洛部落于 1976 年创建的博物馆和文化中心。
该中心坐落在阿尔伯克基印第安学校运营的土地上。它从 1881 年开办到 20 世纪 80 年代初，是数百所联邦资助的寄宿学校之一，旨在剥夺美国原住民儿童的家庭纽带、语言、文化和精神实践。
印度普韦布洛文化中心总裁兼首席执行官莫尼克·弗拉瓜 (Monique Fragua) 表示，游客可以从博物馆的画廊开始，然后参观餐厅，体验普韦布洛文化和热情好客。
印度普韦布洛文化中心总裁兼首席执行官莫尼克·弗拉瓜表示，游客可以通过博物馆的展品和餐厅的美食体验普韦布洛文化。 NPR 的阿德里亚·马尔科姆隐藏标题栏
弗拉瓜说：“无论是通过我们的展览、食物还是礼品店，我们都可以庆祝普韦布洛社区的艺术。”
博物馆咖啡馆并不是美食家的典型目的地，但这家却是。
菜单都是美洲原住民和西南部风格的。菜肴包括蓝玉米辣酱玉米饼馅，您可以选择“圣诞风格”，一种配红智利酱，另一种配绿智利酱。这里有带骨牛小排的智利波索莱，以及自制炸面包上的印度炸玉米饼。还有一道菜在社交媒体上非常流行：泡菜用樱桃酷爱饮料腌制，然后油炸，配上绿色的智利牧场酱。
顾客可以在印第安普韦布洛厨房 (Indian Pueblo Kitchen) 内用餐，这里提供美洲原住民和西南部风格的菜单。 NPR 的阿德里亚·马尔科姆隐藏标题栏
来自 Jemez Pueblo 的 Rita Toledo 是 Indian Pueblo Kitchen 的明星面包师。她的特色菜之一是 biscochitos——一种芳香的酥饼饼干，用茴香调味，并卷上肉桂糖，这是新墨西哥州的州饼干。托莱多对传统的 biscochito 做了一些改变，比如制作了一种智利辣椒版本，最后有一点点刺激，甜热之间达到了很好的平衡。
Indian Pueblo Kitchen 的 biscochitos 版本非常受欢迎，以至于该餐厅还在阿尔伯克基机场内的咖啡馆出售。托莱多每周至少为机场生产 48 打 biscochitos。
托莱多说，她一生都在烘焙，她最喜欢的工作就是擀面团。

title_en: Oregon man and dog narrowly escape being swept away by high tides as officials urge caution at beaches
title_zh: 官员敦促海滩小心谨慎，俄勒冈州男子和狗险些被涨潮卷走
summary: Record-breaking king tides have prompted west coast authorities to warn residents to stay away from beaches The US west coast has seen record-breaking tides this week and authorities have urged residents to avoid beaches, but not everyone is heeding those warn
summary_zh: 破纪录的大潮促使西海岸当局警告居民远离海滩 美国西海岸出现破纪录的大潮
body_en: Oregon man and dog narrowly escape being swept away by high tides as officials urge caution at beaches | West Coast
Record-breaking king tides have prompted west coast authorities to warn residents to stay away from beaches
The US west coast has seen record-breaking tides this week and authorities have urged residents to avoid beaches, but not everyone is heeding those warnings.

In Cannon Beach, Oregon , viral footage showed a man and his dog nearly getting swept away by a so-called king tide on Tuesday morning. The man had been standing on a staircase holding his leashed dog, who was walking in the sand, when the water suddenly surged, knocking him off his feet.
California on edge as high tides and floods set to wreak havoc over Thanksgiving. Here is what to know

They ultimately escaped without injury, according to the Cannon Beach police department. Earlier that morning, police had cited the same man for driving on the shoreline. He had reportedly “indicated” to an officer he wanted to get a better look at the high tides.
Other footage captured around Cannon Beach on Tuesday morning showed a jogger narrowly avoiding a major wave, while another stood amid the wave seemingly filming.

King tides are the highest tide cycles of the year. This winter, conditions caused by the super El Niño have pushed these tides to record levels, contributing to widespread flooding, powerful waves and coastal erosion.
The Cannon Beach police department advised residents to stay off beaches and keep pets away from the water.

“King tides are an impressive natural phenomenon, but no photograph, video or closer look is worth risking your life, the life of your pet or the lives of the first responders who may be called upon to rescue you,” the police department said in a statement.

A coastal flood advisory is in effect for the region through Thursday, according to the National Weather Service, as “king tides, elevated seas, and the arrival of fresh swells likely lead to tidal overflow”.
body_zh: 官员敦促海滩小心谨慎，俄勒冈州男子和狗险些被涨潮卷走西海岸
破纪录的大潮促使西海岸当局警告居民远离海滩
美国西海岸本周出现了破纪录的潮汐，当局敦促居民避开海滩，但并非所有人都注意到这些警告。
在俄勒冈州坎农海滩，一段疯传的视频显示，周二早上，一名男子和他的狗差点被所谓的大潮卷走。这名男子当时牵着拴着的狗站在楼梯上，狗在沙地上行走，突然水流汹涌，把他冲倒在地。
由于涨潮和洪水对感恩节造成严重破坏，加州陷入紧张状态。这是你需要知道的
据坎农海滩警察局称，他们最终逃脱，没有受伤。当天早上早些时候，警方指控同一名男子在海岸线上开车。据报道，他曾向一名官员“表示”他想更好地观察涨潮情况。
周二早上在坎农海滩附近拍摄的其他镜头显示，一名慢跑者险些避开了大浪，而另一名慢跑者则站在海浪中，似乎正在拍摄。
王潮是一年中最高的潮汐周期。今年冬天，超级厄尔尼诺现象导致潮汐达到创纪录水平，导致大面积洪水、巨浪和海岸侵蚀。
坎农海滩警察局建议居民远离海滩，并让宠物远离水面。
警察局在一份声明中表示：“大潮是一种令人印象深刻的自然现象，但任何照片、视频或近距离观察都不值得拿你的生命、你的宠物的生命或可能被要求营救你的急救人员的生命冒险。”
据国家气象局称，沿海洪水警告对该地区的影响持续到周四，因为“大潮、海平面上升和新涌浪的到来可能导致潮汐溢出”。

title_en: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
title_zh: 梅西百货感恩节游行被推迟，强风暴扰乱假日旅行
summary: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.
summary_zh: 预计极端天气将影响约8150万人的出行计划，这些极端天气引发了强风、高潮、大雨和洪水。
body_en: Storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed : NPR

Storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.
Storms expected on both coasts as millions travel for Thanksgiving

Workers inflate the Spider-Man balloon during Macy's Balloon Inflation 2026 on November 25, 2026 in New York City. Macy's plans to celebrate its 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade with a record 100 inflatables, but forecasted high winds are threatening to ground the giant balloons. Adam Gray/Getty Images hide caption

Tens of millions of people are bracing for delays at airports and highways across the country on Thursday, as powerful storms across the United States threatened to disrupt travel for the Thanksgiving holiday.
With millions going home for Thanksgiving, it's the 'Super Bowl' of air travel

On the West Coast, high tides have flooded streets along California's shorelines and knocked off a part of Pacifica Pier. The floods have also prompted evacuation warnings. On the East Coast, authorities are preparing to weather the impact of a storm making its way up into New England from the southeast with strong winds and heavy rain. Snow was also forecast in parts of the Midwest.

A firefighter and an official carry a water pump as coastal floodwaters flow in the Sunset Beach community during high tide on November 25, 2026 in Huntington Beach, California. Potentially record-breaking "king tides," combined with elevated surf and a large Pacific swell, are bringing coastal flooding to Southern California during Thanksgiving week, with the greatest impacts anticipated today and tomorrow. Mario Tama/Getty Images hide caption
Some 81.5 million people in the U.S. are expected to travel for the holiday between Thursday and Monday, according to AAA .

Hundreds of flights had already been cancelled or delayed by early morning Thursday, particularly on the East Coast, where authorities have warned people to stay home as the storm barrels through. The majority of people are expected to travel by car for the holidays, and the winter weather could affect their plans due to visibility issues on the road.
Passengers wait at the departure gates at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport in Arlington, Virginia on November 25, 2026. DANIEL SLIM/AFP via Getty Images hide caption
Richard Bann, a meteorologist with the National Weather Service Weather Prediction Center, told NPR that the East Coast storm remained the main concern, calling it a "multi-hazard" storm.

"It's going to be getting better organized as we go through the day, and it'll be spreading a considerable amount of wind, heavy rain. The real concern with this thing is going to be coastal flooding," Bann said.
Meteorologist Matthew Cappucci with The Washington Post and MyRadar told NPR the storm's magnitude at this time of the year was "unusual."
"We would expect this in deep winter," Cappucci said.
The storm in the East Coast, however, is expected to mostly clear out by Saturday, easing weekend travel for those returning from Thanksgiving gatherings.
Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade in New York City delayed
Beyond travel, several Thanksgiving parades have also been affected by severe weather.

The incoming storm is expected to cause high winds in New York City, prompting Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Wednesday to delay the city's famous Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade. Organizers were already inflating the iconic giant balloons for the parade on Wednesday when officials announced the decision.
body_zh: 梅西百货感恩节游行被推迟，暴风雨扰乱了假期旅行：NPR
由于梅西百货感恩节大游行被推迟，暴风雨扰乱了假期旅行带来强风、涨潮、暴雨和洪水的极端天气预计将影响大约 8150 万人穿越美国的旅行计划。
数百万人过感恩节，预计两岸都会遭遇风暴
2026 年 11 月 25 日，纽约市，工人们在 2026 年梅西百货气球充气活动期间为蜘蛛侠气球充气。梅西百货计划用创纪录的 100 个充气气球来庆祝其第 100 届感恩节游行，但预计大风可能会使巨型气球停飞。亚当·格雷/盖蒂图片社隐藏标题栏
周四，美国各地的强风暴可能会扰乱感恩节假期的旅行，数以千万计的人正准备迎接全国各地机场和高速公路的延误。
数百万人回家过感恩节，这是航空旅行的“超级碗”
在西海岸，涨潮淹没了加州海岸线的街道，并冲毁了帕西菲卡码头的一部分。洪水还引发了疏散警告。在东海岸，当局正在准备应对一场风暴的影响，这场风暴从东南部进入新英格兰，带来强风和大雨。预计中西部部分地区也会下雪。
2026 年 11 月 25 日，加利福尼亚州亨廷顿海滩，涨潮期间，一名消防员和一名官员携带水泵，沿海洪水涌入日落海滩社区。可能破纪录的“大潮”，加上海浪升高和太平洋巨浪，将在感恩节期间给南加州带来沿海洪水，预计今天和明天的影响将最为严重。马里奥多摩/盖蒂图片社隐藏标题栏
据 AAA 称，预计周四至周一美国将有约 8150 万人出行度假。
截至周四凌晨，数百架航班已被取消或延误，尤其是在东海岸，当局警告人们在风暴袭来时待在家里。大多数人预计在假期期间驾车出行，由于道路能见度问题，冬季天气可能会影响他们的计划。
2026 年 11 月 25 日，乘客在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿罗纳德·里根华盛顿国家机场的登机口等候。丹尼尔·斯利姆 / 法新社，盖蒂图片社 隐藏标题栏
美国国家气象局天气预报中心的气象学家理查德·班恩 (Richard Bann) 告诉 NPR，东海岸风暴仍然是主要关注点，称其为“多灾种”风暴。
班恩说：“随着这一天的到来，天气将会变得更加井井有条，并且会带来大量的风和大雨。真正令人担忧的是沿海洪水。”
《华盛顿邮报》和 MyRadar 的气象学家马修·卡普奇 (Matthew Cappucci) 告诉 NPR，每年这个时候的风暴强度“不同寻常”。
“我们预计这将发生在深冬，”卡普奇说。
然而，东海岸的风暴预计将在周六基本消失，从而缓解那些从感恩节聚会返回的人的周末出行。
纽约梅西百货感恩节大游行推迟
除了旅行之外，一些感恩节游行也受到恶劣天气的影响。
即将到来的风暴预计将在纽约市引发大风，促使市长佐兰·马姆达尼周三推迟该市著名的梅西百货感恩节游行。周三，当官员宣布这一决定时，组织者已经开始为游行的标志性巨型气球充气。

title_en: 53 incoming House Democrats to boycott Harvard orientation in support of graduate students’ strike
title_zh: 53名即将上任的众议院民主党人抵制哈佛迎新活动，支持研究生罢工
summary: ‘We have been informed that to attend your event we would be required to cross a union picket line,’ the Democrats say US politics live – latest updates Fifty-three newly elected members of Congress told Harvard University on Tuesday that they will boycott an
summary_zh: 民主党人表示，“我们已获悉，要参加你们的活动，我们将需要跨越工会纠察线”——最新动态
body_en: 53 incoming House Democrats to boycott Harvard orientation in support of graduate students’ strike | Harvard University
‘We have been informed that to attend your event we would be required to cross a union picket line,’ the Democrats say

Fifty-three newly elected members of Congress told Harvard University on Tuesday that they will boycott an informal orientation program at Harvard’s Kennedy School next month in support of the school’s striking graduate students union .

In a letter to the university’s administrators, the incoming House Democrats expressed thanks for their invitations to the Bipartisan Program for Newly Elected Members of Congress, in which more than 800 members have participated since 1972.

“However, as much as we would like to attend, we have been informed that to attend your event we would be required to cross a union picket line,” the new lawmakers wrote. “From our understanding, thousands of UAW members who belong to the Harvard Graduate Students Union (HGSU-UAW Local 5118) are on strike, seeking basic provisions like a cost of living increase. In addition, thousands of members of the Harvard Academic Workers (HAW-UAW) have been bargaining for a first contract for over two years and recently went on a week-long strike.

“While we appreciate the invitation to Harvard’s Institute of Politics, we will not cross a picket line. So long as these workers are on strike, any trip we take to Harvard would be to stand in solidarity with our striking union siblings,” they added.
Three of the new House members, Sam Forstag of Montana, Clare Valdez of New York and Bob Brooks of Pennsylvania, posted a social media video statement in support of the striking workers.

“ For some of those workers at Harvard, it’s been more than two years since they organized that they have been fighting just to get a contract with basic protections against harassment at the workplace, basic discrimination protections and a cost of living raise to $50,000 a year,” Forstag said in the video. “Harvard has an endowment of $68 billion; they can afford to pay people a living wage. Our brothers and sisters there deserve a fair contract.

“So to all the workers at Harvard, we’ve got your back,” he added. “And to the administration at Harvard, well, if me and so many other members of Congress are going to be making a trip out there in December, it’s going to be to join our brothers and sisters on the picket line.”

“This freshman class stands with the working class,” Valdez added in a social media post . “Solidarity to my @UAW @hgsuuaw siblings at Harvard who are holding the line for what every worker deserves: living wages, workplace protections, and dignity on the job.”

In a post on X, incoming Democrat Richard Ojeda of North Carolina wrote: “I’ll never cross a picket line. You can find me shoulder to shoulder in solidarity fighting the good fight with our union siblings, full stop.”
The incoming Democrats are part of the largest freshman class in the US House in three decades. In January, more than 100 new members will be sworn into Congress’s lower chamber.
body_zh: 53名即将上任的众议院民主党人抵制哈佛迎新活动，支持研究生罢工|哈佛大学
民主党人说，我们被告知，要参加你们的活动，我们将被要求跨越工会纠察线。
周二，53 名新当选的国会议员告诉哈佛大学，他们将抵制下个月在哈佛大学肯尼迪学院举行的非正式迎新活动，以支持该校罢工的研究生联盟。
在给大学管理人员的一封信中，即将上任的众议院民主党人对邀请参加新当选国会议员两党计划表示感谢，自 1972 年以来已有 800 多名议员参加了该计划。
新立法者写道：“尽管我们很想参加，但我们被告知，要参加你们的活动，我们将被要求跨越工会纠察线。” “据我们了解，哈佛研究生会 (HGSU-UAW Local 5118) 的数千名 UAW 成员正在罢工，寻求提高生活费用等基本条款。此外，哈佛学术工作者 (HAW-UAW) 的数千名成员已经为第一份合同讨价还价了两年多，最近举行了为期一周的罢工。
他们补充说：“虽然我们感谢哈佛大学政治学院的邀请，但我们不会跨越纠察线。只要这些工人还在罢工，我们去哈佛的任何一次旅行都将与我们罢工的工会兄弟姐妹站在一起。”
三名新众议院议员——蒙大拿州的萨姆·福斯塔格、纽约州的克莱尔·瓦尔迪兹和宾夕法尼亚州的鲍勃·布鲁克斯——发布了社交媒体视频声明，支持罢工工人。
福斯塔格在视频中表示：“对于哈佛的一些员工来说，他们组织起来已经两年多了，他们一直在努力争取一份合同，其中包含基本的工作场所骚扰保护、基本的歧视保护以及生活费用提高到每年 5 万美元。” “哈佛拥有 680 亿美元的捐赠基金；他们有能力向人们支付生活工资。我们那里的兄弟姐妹应该得到一份公平的合同。
“所以对于哈佛的所有工作人员，我们会支持你们，”他补充道。 “对于哈佛政府来说，如果我和许多其他国会议员要在 12 月前往那里，那将是与我们的兄弟姐妹一起参加纠察线。”
“这个新生班级与工人阶级站在一起，”瓦尔迪兹在社交媒体帖子中补充道。 “声援我在哈佛的@UAW @hgsuuaw 兄弟姐妹，他们坚守阵线，争取每个工人应得的权利：生活工资、工作场所保护和工作尊严。”
北卡罗来纳州即将上任的民主党议员理查德·奥赫达（Richard Ojeda）在X上发帖写道：“我永远不会越过罢工警戒线。你们会看到我与工会兄弟姐妹们肩并肩、团结一心，为正义事业而战，绝无例外。”
即将上任的民主党人是三十年来美国众议院最大的新生阶层的一部分。一月份，100 多名新议员将宣誓进入国会下议院。

title_en: US inflation hits highest since May after prices climb 3.8% over the last year
title_zh: 美国通胀创5月以来新高，物价较去年上涨3.8%
summary: Rise occurs amid soaring energy prices, according to last inflation reading before a crucial Fed board meeting The sell-off in US tech stocks continued on Wednesday as investors reacted to continued concern over the AI trade and fresh data that showed inflatio
summary_zh: 根据美联储关键会议之前的最新通胀数据，能源价格飙升，美国科技股继续遭到抛售
body_en: US inflation hits highest since May after prices climb 3.8% over the last year | US economy
Rise occurs amid soaring energy prices, according to last inflation reading before a crucial Fed board meeting
The sell-off in US tech stocks continued on Wednesday as investors reacted to continued concern over the AI trade and fresh data that showed inflation jumped in October.

The tech-heavy Nasdaq index was down over 4% on Wednesday morning, while the S&P 500 had lost over 2.5% and the Dow had dropped about 2%. By the end of the day the tech-heavy index was down 0.6%, the S&P had lost 0.25% and the Dow managed a small gain of 0.33%.
After a rally upon the return of CEO Jensen Huang, Nvidia was down 5% at market’s closing on Tuesday and fell another 4% on Wednesday.
High prices force many across the US to scale back for Thanksgiving: ‘We can’t afford the food’
Anthropic shares rose 1% to end the day at $82.79, marginally lower than the $83-a-share price it was listed for during its blockbuster IPO last week.
New data released on Wednesday had shown consumer prices rose an annualized 3.8% in October, the highest rate since May.

This is the last inflation reading before a crucial US Federal Reserve board meeting next month, in which officials are largely expected to hike interest rates for the second time this year. The Fed has set a target inflation rate of 2%, a level not seen since February 2021. Higher interest rates make it more expensive to borrow money, slowing price increases, and raising the price of loans like mortgages and student debt.

Prices rose 0.3% from September to October amid soaring energy prices, according to the personal consumption expenditure index, the Fed’s preferred inflation measure from the commerce department’s Bureau of Economic Analysis.
The data comes after the Bureau of Labor Statistics separately reported prices climbed 0.4% from September to October, higher than economists had anticipated.
Energy prices, including gas prices at the pump, have cooled, going from a high of $4.41 a gallon in early October to $3.61 a gallon by mid-November, according to AAA .
Though Fed officials held rates steady at the last board meeting in late October, minutes from the meeting showed that some expressed concern about inflation’s stickiness.
“A few of them warned that further delay risked allowing high inflation to become entrenched or necessitating a larger and more disruptive tightening later,” the minutes said.

The move would come at a tumultuous time for the US economy. A new survey from the Conference Board released on Tuesday showed consumer confidence had ticked up in November to its highest level since January 2025, probably driven by the shake-up from the midterm elections .

At the same time, US stocks have been fluctuating from a mixture of uncertainty over datacenter regulations, continuing scandals coming out of Nvidia , and overall investor concern about the seemingly limitless amount of money being spent on building AI and the infrastructure to support it.
body_zh: 美国通胀创5月以来新高，物价较去年上涨3.8%美国经济
根据美联储重要会议之前的最新通胀数据，能源价格飙升之际出现上涨
由于投资者对人工智能交易的持续担忧以及显示 10 月份通胀飙升的新数据做出反应，美国科技股的抛售仍在继续。
以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数周三上午下跌超过 4%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌超过 2.5%，道指下跌约 2%。截至收盘，科技股指数下跌 0.6%，标准普尔指数下跌 0.25%，道指小幅上涨 0.33%。
首席执行官黄仁勋回归后，英伟达股价上涨，周二收盘时下跌 5%，周三又下跌 4%。
高物价迫使美国许多人在感恩节缩减开支：“我们买不起食物”
Anthropic 股价当天上涨 1%，收于 82.79 美元，略低于上周其大规模 IPO 期间每股 83 美元的价格。
周三公布的新数据显示，10 月份消费者价格年率上涨 3.8%，为 5 月份以来的最高增幅。
这是下个月重要的美联储理事会会议之前的最后一次通胀数据，人们普遍预计官员们将在这次会议上进行今年第二次加息。美联储设定了 2% 的目标通胀率，这是自 2021 年 2 月以来的最高水平。利率上升使得借贷成本更高，减缓了物价上涨，并提高了抵押贷款和学生债务等贷款的价格。
根据美国商务部经济分析局美联储首选的通胀指标个人消费支出指数，由于能源价格飙升，9月至10月物价上涨了0.3%。
该数据发布之前，美国劳工统计局单独报告称，9 月至 10 月价格上涨 0.4%，高于经济学家的预期。
根据 AAA 的数据，包括加油站天然气价格在内的能源价格已经降温，从 10 月初的每加仑 4.41 美元的高位降至 11 月中旬的每加仑 3.61 美元。
尽管美联储官员在十月底的最后一次董事会会议上维持利率不变，但会议纪要显示，一些人对通胀的粘性表示担忧。
会议纪要称，“他们中的一些人警告称，进一步拖延可能会导致高通胀根深蒂固，或者需要稍后实施更大规模、更具破坏性的紧缩政策。”
此举正值美国经济动荡时期。世界大型企业联合会周二发布的一项新调查显示，11 月消费者信心指数升至 2025 年 1 月以来的最高水平，这可能是受到中期选​​举的影响。
与此同时，美国股市一直在波动，原因包括数据中心法规的不确定性、英伟达不断爆出的丑闻，以及投资者对看似无限的资金用于构建人工智能及其支持基础设施的担忧。

title_en: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
title_zh: FCC 表示 SpaceX 可以为太空数据中心部署 100 万颗卫星。科学家对此表示怀疑
summary: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.
summary_zh: 特朗普政府为埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 开绿灯，允许其部署 100 万颗卫星，据称这些卫星将在太空中创建数据中心，这是一项举措
body_en: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space : NPR

FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.
FILE - Elon Musk listens as President Donald Trump speaks during an event at the U.S. Institute of Peace, Oct. 8, 2026, in Washington. Julia Demaree Nikhinson/AP hide caption

The Trump administration on Wednesday gave SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a long-lofty goal of Elon Musk's rocket company, in a move that has raised both skepticism and alarm among some scientists.
Big tech's next move is to put data centers in space. Can it work?

The U.S. Federal Communications Commission lauded its authorization as a historic first amid the artificial intelligence race. It said that SpaceX's one million "orbital compute modules" (forming a data center constellation called "Starmind") would process massive amounts of data that would be used back on Earth — and bring humans closer to harnessing "the full power of the sun."

"America is leading the world into the era of super intelligence," FCC Chairman Brendan Carr, who was appointed by Republican President Donald Trump, said in a statement. He added that Wednesday's move "opens a bold new frontier."

A lengthier authorization order published by the FCC noted that the company must deploy at least "one authorized space station" by 2033 — and then gradually add more and more through 2040. Musk welcomed the decision over social media.

The world's richest man has long vowed to form vast, solar-powered data centers in space to help run AI tools on Earth. But scientists and industry experts have stressed enormous technical and financial obstacles, as well as a host of environmental concerns.
Adam Becker, an astrophysicist and author, called the prospect of launching a million satellites into space to create data centers "a fantasy."
"It's not going to happen," he said Wednesday.
Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space

Proponents of data centers in space argue that capturing the sun's energy would ease pressure on power grids and cut demand for sprawling computing warehouses on Earth (and resources like water needed to cool them). Space seems to offer a solution because it is cold, but it is also a vacuum, trapping heat inside objects much like a thermos. Becker explained that there are "basic physical limits" to otherwise radiating that heat out — and sending lots of smaller satellites could potentially carry the necessary material combined, but it would be expensive and difficult.
He and others also point to additional risks, such as atmospheric pollution through launches and reentries, as well as possible in-orbit collisions that could impact other essential satellites.

"You could end up with a cascading set of space junk collisions," said Becker, noting such crashes could create "a cloud of debris" in the low Earth orbit — where many weather and telecommunication satellites are also found.
How powerful is Elon Musk? How his political influence compares to past U.S. moguls

In its ruling, the FCC maintained that SpaceX's proposed Starmind constellation operates consistently with its orbital debris rules. It also acknowledged that it had received a "substantial number" of public comments leading up to its authorization Wednesday, including petitions to deny SpaceX's request. But the regulator maintained that deploying the satellites "serves the public interest" — and said that it dismissed topics that it didn't have authority over, such as environmental concerns.
The American Astronomical Society, satellite communication company Viasat and Amazon-owned Kuiper Systems were among those who called on the regulator to deny SpaceX's proposed data centers in space.

In a statement Wednesday, the AAS said it was "disheartened and dismayed" by the FCC's decision. The organization said that SpaceX's proposed position of data centers in low Earth orbit would undermine decades of federal investment in astronomical facilities and "the ability of astronomers and the public to enjoy and study the night sky."
body_zh: FCC 表示 SpaceX 可以为太空数据中心部署 100 万颗卫星：NPR
FCC 称 SpaceX 可在太空部署 100 万颗卫星用于太空数据中心特朗普政府为埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 部署 100 万颗卫星开了绿灯，据称这些卫星将在太空创建数据中心，此举引起了科学家的怀疑。
文件 - 埃隆·马斯克于 2026 年 10 月 8 日在华盛顿美国和平研究所举行的一次活动中聆听唐纳德·特朗普总统的讲话。朱莉娅·德玛丽·尼金森/美联社隐藏标题栏
特朗普政府周三批准 SpaceX 部署 100 万颗卫星，据称这些卫星将在太空创建数据中心，这是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 火箭公司的长期崇高目标，此举引起了一些科学家的怀疑和警惕。
大型科技公司的下一步行动是将数据中心置于太空中。能行吗？
美国联邦通信委员会称赞其授权是人工智能竞赛中的历史性首次。据称，SpaceX 的 100 万个“轨道计算模块”（形成一个名为“Starmind”的数据中心星座）将处理大量数据，这些数据将在地球上使用，并使人类更接近利用“太阳的全部力量”。
由共和党总统唐纳德·特朗普任命的 FCC 主席布伦丹·卡尔在一份声明中表示：“美国正在引领世界进入超级智能时代。”他补充说，周三的举动“开辟了一个大胆的新领域”。
FCC 发布的一份更长的授权令指出，该公司必须在 2033 年之前部署至少“一个授权空间站”，然后到 2040 年逐步增加更多空间站。马斯克在社交媒体上对这一决定表示欢迎。
这位世界首富长期以来一直发誓要在太空建立庞大的太阳能数据中心，以帮助在地球上运行人工智能工具。但科学家和行业专家强调了巨大的技术和财务障碍，以及一系列环境问题。
天体物理学家兼作家亚当·贝克尔 (Adam Becker) 称，向太空发射一百万颗卫星来创建数据中心的前景是“一个幻想”。
“这不会发生，”他周三表示。
谷歌推出 Project Suncatcher，迈向太空人工智能数据中心的一步
太空数据中心的支持者认为，捕获太阳能将减轻电网的压力，并减少对地球上庞大的计算仓库的需求（以及冷却它们所需的水等资源）。太空似乎提供了一个解决方案，因为它很冷，但它也是真空，将热量困在物体内部，就像热水瓶一样。贝克尔解释说，以其他方式辐射热量存在“基本物理限制”，并且发送大量较小的卫星可能会携带必要的材料组合，但这将是昂贵且困难的。
他和其他人还指出了其他风险，例如发射和再入造成的大气污染，以及可能影响其他重要卫星的在轨碰撞。
贝克尔说：“最终可能会发生一系列级联的太空垃圾碰撞。”他指出，此类碰撞可能会在近地轨道上产生“碎片云”，那里还发现了许多气象和电信卫星。
埃隆·马斯克有多强大？他的政治影响力与过去的美国大亨相比如何
FCC 在裁决中坚称 SpaceX 提议的 Starmind 星座的运行符合其轨道碎片规则。它还承认，在周三获得授权之前，它收到了“大量”公众意见，其中包括拒绝 SpaceX 请求的请愿书。但监管机构坚持认为，部署卫星“符合公共利益”，并表示它驳回了其无权处理的话题，例如环境问题。
美国天文学会、卫星通信公司 Viasat 和亚马逊旗下的柯伊伯系统公司等都呼吁监管机构拒绝 SpaceX 提议的太空数据中心。
AAS 在周三的一份声明中表示，它对 FCC 的决定感到“沮丧和沮丧”。该组织表示，SpaceX 提议在近地轨道设立数据中心将损害联邦政府数十年来对天文设施的投资，以及“天文学家和公众欣赏和研究夜空的能力”。

title_en: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
title_zh: 新浪潮偶像杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 吉他手安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 去世，享年 65 岁
summary: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio".
summary_zh: 泰勒在 2022 年透露了他与第四期转移性前列腺癌的斗争。他是 20 世纪 80 年代英国乐队 Duran Duran 的吉他手，该乐队的流行歌曲
body_en: FILE - Music group Duran Duran poses at The Sony Club in New York, Oct. 12, 2004. From left are John Taylor, Nick Rhodes, Roger Taylor, Simon Le Bon and Andy Taylor. Jim Cooper/AP hide caption

Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, whose huge pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf," "The Reflex" and "Rio" and were inextricably linked to the launch of MTV, has died. He was 65.
Taylor's death was confirmed by his family and bandmates in a statement posted on social media and Duran Duran's website.

"From the moment he arrived in Birmingham from the North East with a guitar and an unshakeable belief in what we could become, he brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music. His playing drove the songs that took us around the world, and with a dry wit that was matched only by his wonderfully unsentimental, no-nonsense outlook on life he kept us grounded and gave the band its edge through the extraordinary years that followed," the band said.
FILE - Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor listens as a fellow band member answers a question at a news conference in Hong Kong, Aug. 26, 2004. Lo Sai-hung/AP hide caption

On the night he was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in November 2022, Taylor revealed that he had been battling Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer for several years and was unable to attend.
"I would like to thank each of my brothers in this great band," he wrote. "You can dream about what happened to us but to experience it, on one's own terms, as mates, was beyond incredible."

The two-time Grammy Award-winners had nine gold records and six platinum ones, with 20 Top 20 singles in the U.K. and 18 in the U.S. They were two-time Ivor Novello Award winners and are MTV Video Visionary Award recipients.

The band's 1981 debut album "Duran Duran" had their first hit single, "Planet Earth," but it was "Rio" that transformed them into trans-Atlantic stars. The Rock Hall explained their appeal this way: "They were new wave outsiders who became music video stars — 'Tiger Beat' fashion pinups who rocked arenas."
How music videos made Duran Duran massively famous

The band's imperial stage occurred with a trio of hit albums between 1981 and 1983, with such dance-floor barnburners as "Girls on Film" and "Union of the Snake" and the moody ballads "The Chauffeur" and "Save a Prayer." Other hits in the coming years included "The Wild Boys," "New Moon on Monday" and "Come Undone." Their popularity was cemented when they recorded the James Bond theme song "A View to a Kill" and earned a slot at Live Aid in 1985.

Mixing fashion, pioneering synthesizers and glam-pop swagger, the telegenic band were all over radio and young people's walls, with bassist John Taylor and singer Simon Le Bon becoming heartthrobs and the band being labeled part of the New Romantics. Princess Diana was known to be a fan, which meant a lot to the band.
Duran Duran's Simon Le Bon reflects on the 'Future Past'
"It worked well for us," drummer Roger Taylor told Rolling Stone. "It was genuine. I don't think it was some sort of PR stunt. It was massive for us because she was the No. 1 icon of the early '80s."

The band's success was in large part due to their videos, including their Antigua-set song "Rio," which featured shots of the band in pastel suits sailing confidently on a yacht. For the album "Rio," they shot three music videos in Sri Lanka — including "Save a Prayer," which had John Taylor getting sprayed by an elephant — and two in Antigua, feeding MTV's need to have a stream of visuals, something classic rock didn't have.

"A lot of the success of the album is down to the power of the videos and the way it made the band omnipresent around the globe," Le Bon told The Daily Beast in 2012. Andy Taylor agreed: "I don't think we could have done it without MTV."

John Taylor and keyboardist Nick Rhodes started the band as teenagers in the northern city of Birmingham in 1978, with a name inspired by a character in the Jane Fonda-starring sci-fi movie "Barbarella." Roger Taylor, Le Bon and Andy Taylor joined soon after, with the British press referring to them as the "Fab Five." Andy Taylor answered an ad in Melody Maker music magazine for a "Live-Wire Guitarist." (None of the Taylors were related.)

"We all grew up on the same vinyl records and live gigs, from David Bowie to Roxy Music, The Sex Pistols and, of course, Chic. I could go to all those places as a player and developed a hybrid guitar style that fitted this amazing concept of a band," Andy Taylor wrote in a letter read by the band during their Rock Hall induction.
Behind massive success, Taylor and bandmates were distant
body_zh: 文件 - 音乐团体 Duran Duran 于 2004 年 10 月 12 日在纽约索尼俱乐部摆出姿势。左起依次为约翰·泰勒、尼克·罗兹、罗杰·泰勒、西蒙·勒邦和安迪·泰勒。吉姆·库珀/美联社隐藏标题栏
安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 是 20 世纪 80 年代英国新浪潮乐队杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 的原吉他手，他的热门流行歌曲包括《Hungry Like the Wolf》、《The Reflex》和《Rio》，并且与 MTV 的推出有着千丝万缕的联系。他 65 岁了。
泰勒的家人和乐队成员在社交媒体和杜兰·杜兰的网站上发布的一份声明中证实了泰勒的去世。
乐队表示：“从他带着吉他从东北来到伯明翰的那一刻起，他对我们能够成为什么样的人有着不可动摇的信念，他给我们的音乐带来了不可磨灭的热情和昂扬。他的演奏带动了我们的歌曲，让我们环游世界，他的冷幽默与他极其冷静、严肃的人生观相匹配，让我们脚踏实地，并在接下来的非凡岁月中为乐队带来了优势，”乐队说道。
文件 - 2004 年 8 月 26 日，杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 吉他手安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 在香港举行的新闻发布会上聆听乐队成员回答问题。Lo Sai-hung/美联社 隐藏标题栏
2022 年 11 月，泰勒入选摇滚名人堂当晚，他透露，他多年来一直在与第四期转移性前列腺癌作斗争，因此无法出席。
“我要感谢这个伟大乐队中的每一位兄弟，”他写道。 “你可以想象发生在我们身上的事情，但作为伙伴，以自己的方式经历它，真是难以置信。”
这对两届格莱美奖得主拥有 9 张金唱片和 6 张白金唱片，其中 20 首单曲在英国排名前 20 名，18 首单曲在美国排名前 20。他们是两届艾弗·诺韦洛奖得主和 MTV 视频远见奖获得者。
乐队 1981 年的首张专辑《Duran Duran》中收录了他们的第一首热门单曲《Planet Earth》，但正是《Rio》让他们成为了跨大西洋明星。摇滚厅这样解释他们的吸引力：“他们是成为音乐视频明星的新浪潮局外人——震撼舞台的‘Tiger Beat’时尚女郎。”
音乐视频如何让杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 名声大噪

1981 年至 1983 年间，乐队凭借三张热门专辑登上了帝国舞台，其中包括《Girls on Film》和《Union of the Snake》等舞池热门歌曲，以及喜怒无常的民谣《The Chauffeur》和《Save a Prayer》。接下来几年的其他热门歌曲包括《The Wild Boys》、《周一新月》和《Come Undone》。当他们录制了詹姆斯·邦德的主题曲“A View to a Kill”并在 1985 年赢得了 Live Aid 的一席之地后，他们的受欢迎程度得到了巩固。
这支上镜乐队将时尚、先锋合成器和华丽流行音乐融为一体，遍布广播电台和年轻人的墙壁，贝斯手约翰·泰勒和歌手西蒙·勒邦成为万人迷，乐队被贴上新浪漫主义的标签。众所周知，戴安娜王妃是乐队的粉丝，这对乐队意义重大。
杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 饰演的西蒙·勒邦 (Simon Le Bon) 反思“未来的过去”
“这对我们来说效果很好，”鼓手罗杰泰勒告诉滚石杂志。 “这是真诚的。我不认为这是某种公关噱头。这对我们来说意义重大，因为她是 80 年代初的第一偶像。”
乐队的成功在很大程度上归功于他们的视频，包括他们以安提瓜岛为背景的歌曲“Rio”，其中的镜头是乐队穿着柔和的西装在游艇上自信地航行。为了专辑《Rio》，他们在斯里兰卡拍摄了三部音乐视频，其中包括约翰·泰勒被大象喷洒的《Save a Prayer》，另外两部在安提瓜岛拍摄，满足了 MTV 对视觉效果的需求，而这是经典摇滚所不具备的。
勒邦在 2012 年告诉《每日野兽报》：“这张专辑的成功在很大程度上要归功于视频的力量以及它让乐队在全球无所不在的方式。”安迪·泰勒也表示同意：“我认为如果没有 MTV，我们不可能做到这一点。”

1978 年，约翰·泰勒 (John Taylor) 和键盘手尼克·罗兹 (Nick Rhodes) 在北部城市伯明翰十几岁的时候就组建了乐队，乐队的名字灵感来自于简·方达 (Jane Fonda) 主演的科幻电影《芭芭拉》(Barbarella) 中的一个角色。罗杰·泰勒、勒邦和安迪·泰勒不久后加入，英国媒体称他们为“五人组”。安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 在 Melody Maker 音乐杂志上接了一则“Live-Wire 吉他手”广告。 （泰勒一家都没有亲属关系。）
“我们都是在同样的黑胶唱片和现场演出中长大的，从 David Bowie 到 Roxy Music、The Sex Pistols，当然还有 Chic。我可以作为一名演奏者去所有这些地方，并开发出一种混合吉他风格，适合这个令人惊叹的乐队概念，”安迪·泰勒在乐队在摇滚厅入职典礼上宣读的一封信中写道。

title_en: Trump prepares new round of tariffs on China, other U.S. trading partners
title_zh: 特朗普准备对中国和其他美国贸易伙伴征收新一轮关税
summary: The Trump administration proposed a new round of tariffs targeting China, the European Union and 12 other economies over policies it says have created excess industrial capacity. Why it matters: Trump officials are pressing ahead with his trade agenda despite
summary_zh: 特朗普政府提议对中国、欧盟和其他 12 个经济体征收新一轮关税，理由是其所制定的政策
body_en: The Trump administration proposed a new round of tariffs targeting China, the European Union and 12 other economies over policies it says have created excess industrial capacity.
Why it matters: Trump officials are pressing ahead with his trade agenda despite a Democratic midterm sweep fueled by affordability concerns.
Post-election polling indicates voters overwhelmingly want tariffs to stay at current levels or decline. There's relatively little support — even among Trump's base — for them rising.
Driving the news: The tariffs are the result of a trade investigation that launched in March
The proposed tariffs largely target specific goods, a narrower approach than the sweeping import levies the administration has previously imposed.
China is the exception: The proposed 20% tariff would apply to most Chinese imports, with that rate calibrated to preserve the nations' trade truce.
These new tariffs would not be added to existing ones aimed at combating forced labor or certain sector-specific tariffs, a senior U.S. official said.
The official added that the rate could rise to 40% if trade talks break down or China fails to live up to its commitments.
Between the lines: The proposed tariff rates for other major trading partners are consistent with parameters set out in trade deals, the official said.
Trade deals struck with the EU, Japan and South Korea last year established 15% tariff rates on most goods.
Other economies targeted include Taiwan, India, Indonesia and Vietnam.
On average, the proposals would raise existing tariff rates on targeted trading partners by roughly 5 percentage points, the official estimated.

The big picture: The investigation was conducted under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974. The administration contends that foreign industrial policies encourage companies to produce more goods than global demand can absorb, undercutting U.S. manufacturers.
The proposed tariffs are subject to a public comment period and hearings, with the levies taking effect as early as January, the official said.

What they're saying: In response to reports of the proposed tariffs , China dismissed U.S. claims of industrial overcapacity as a "false proposition" and urged Washington to preserve stable trade relations.
The prospect of renewed tariffs weighed on global stocks, particularly Asian markets, overnight.
U.S. futures were sharply lower early Wednesday as well.

Of note: The U.S. is also proposing tougher trade measures against Brazil, after imposing 25% tariffs in July over alleged unfair trade practices amid tensions between Trump and Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
The administration proposes raising tariffs on sugar imports exceeding existing quotas (regardless of origin) and imposing a 10% levy on previously exempt Brazilian aircraft, a U.S. official said.
The bottom line: Trump's tariff agenda is moving forward as Democrats in the incoming Congress look to curb presidential authority over trade policy and lower Americans' costs .
body_zh: 特朗普政府提议对中国、欧盟和其他 12 个经济体征收新一轮关税，称其政策造成了工业产能过剩。
为什么重要：尽管民主党因负担能力担忧而在中期选举中大获全胜，但特朗普官员仍在推进他的贸易议程。
选举后的民意调查显示，绝大多数选民希望关税保持在当前水平或下降。即使在特朗普的支持者中，对他们崛起的支持也相对较少。
推动新闻：关税是三月份启动的贸易调查的结果
拟议的关税主要针对特定​​商品，比政府此前征收的全面进口税的范围更窄。
中国是个例外：提议的 20% 关税将适用于大多数中国进口产品，该税率经过调整以维持两国的贸易休战。
一位美国高级官员表示，这些新关税不会添加到旨在打击强迫劳动或某些特定行业的现有关税中。
该官员补充说，如果贸易谈判破裂或中国未能履行其承诺，税率可能升至 40%。
言外之意是：该官员表示，其他主要贸易伙伴的拟议关税税率与贸易协议中规定的参数一致。
去年与欧盟、日本和韩国达成的贸易协议规定对大多数商品征收 15% 的关税。
其他目标经济体包括台湾、印度、印度尼西亚和越南。
该官员估计，平均而言，这些提案将使目标贸易伙伴的现有关税税率提高约 5 个百分点。
总体情况：调查是根据 1974 年《贸易法》第 301 条进行的。政府认为，外国产业政策鼓励企业生产超出全球需求所能吸收的商品，从而削弱了美国制造商的利益。
这位官员表示，拟议的关税将接受公众意见征询期和听证会，最早将于一月份生效。
他们的言论：针对拟议关税的报道，中国驳斥了美国关于工业产能过剩的说法，称其为“错误主张”，并敦促华盛顿保持稳定的贸易关系。
隔夜，新关税的前景令全球股市，尤其是亚洲市场承压。
周三早些时候美国期货也大幅走低。
值得注意的是：在特朗普与巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦之间关系紧张之际，美国7月因涉嫌不公平贸易行为而对巴西征收25%的关税，随后美国还提议对巴西采取更严厉的贸易措施。
一位美国官员表示，美国政府提议对超过现有配额（无论原产地）的食糖进口提高关税，并对之前豁免的巴西飞机征收 10% 的关税。
底线是：特朗普的关税议程正在向前推进，即将上任的国会中的民主党人希望限制总统在贸易政策上的权威并降低美国人的成本。
