title_en: Republicans’ midterm reckoning comes for the RNC
title_zh: 共和党的中期清算即将到来
summary: President Donald Trump’s handpicked chair is fending off a challenge from his own colleague as Republicans grapple with who should pay the price for midterm losses.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统精心挑选的主席正在抵御来自他自己的同事的挑战，共和党人正在努力解决谁应该为这一目标付出代价的问题。
body_en: The chair of the Republican National Committee is scrambling to avoid becoming the party’s midterms scapegoat.

With President Donald Trump’s backing, Joe Gruters would normally be a lock to retain his position as RNC chair. But after this month’s brutal midterm losses, he is now trying to fend off an upstart and surprisingly strong challenge from co-chair KC Crosbie ahead of the January leadership election. As both candidates jockey behind the scenes for support, deep divisions have emerged between members over who bears responsibility for the wipeout earlier this month and what comes next.

Party leaders have been reluctant to publicly point fingers at Trump and his unpopular agenda. Instead, conversations with more than two dozen RNC members and operatives familiar with the committee’s dynamics reveal that some are channeling their frustration toward Gruters. Even as his supporters argue he’s being unfairly blamed for a difficult political environment, Gruters could still become the fall guy.
For some of Gruters’ critics, the decision is simple: Someone must pay for the once-unthinkable losses.

“It is time for new leadership. That's nothing against Joe at all,” said Kentucky GOP Chair Robert Benvenuti, who plans to vote for Crosbie. “But different times require different leadership, different types of leaders.”

An undecided RNC member added: “There's an awful lot of anger.” That member, granted anonymity to speak candidly about private conversations, described members questioning whether to “rubber stamp the guy that rightly or wrongly is seen as the architect of this mess.”

The debate within the RNC — whether to break with the Trump-backed candidate or stick with the status quo — mirrors the broader reckoning underway in the GOP over how closely to align with the president moving forward. Many Republicans have resigned themselves to Trump’s continued dominance over the next two years, but some RNC members have already begun to agitate for change in other ways, including by calling for an autopsy of the midterms and for congressional leadership elections to be delayed.

Several RNC members said Gruters helped the committee raise millions this cycle, arguing that alone is a key part of his job and he handled it well. Others were frustrated that the RNC didn’t engage or spend money in their states earlier. And some members criticized Gruters for allowing the RNC to become overly enmeshed in the White House’s political operation.

“The party raised a lot of money, and we spent it. I don't think that there's a whole lot of that that can be laid at [Gruters’] feet,” said West Virginia GOP chair Josh Holstein, who said he has not yet committed either way in the leadership race. “At the same time, I know there's a lot of members of the committee that feel we need to go a different direction, and that the RNC needs to be a little more autonomous in its decision making.”
The RNC and Crosbie declined to comment. The White House did not respond to a request for comment.
The Gruters campaign said in a statement that RNC members “are rallying behind Chairman Gruters because they know he will never stop fighting for Republicans.”

“Chairman Joe Gruters has 25 years of experience at every level of the Republican Party, shattering fundraising records, building the largest election integrity operation in party history, and advancing President Trump’s agenda,” the campaign said.

The outcome of the leadership race, which will be determined by a secret ballot, will test just how far RNC members are willing to go to change course — even if it means defying Trump. And the stakes are enormous, with the RNC playing a key role in the presidential race, including running the GOP primary debates, hosting the party’s 2028 convention and supporting the eventual nominee.

Complicating the calculation is Trump’s own involvement: The president has been a vocal supporter of Gruters and has privately suggested that if Crosbie wins the leadership battle, he wouldn’t assist the RNC with fundraising ahead of 2028, according to two people familiar with the threat who were granted anonymity to speak about private details. The threat was first reported by Axios .
It’s an apparent acknowledgement that even Trump knows it’s a real contest — and that his chosen candidate may become a scapegoat.

Vice President JD Vance, who also serves as the RNC’s finance chair and is considering a presidential bid, has privately offered to assist Gruters’ reelection campaign, according to a person with direct knowledge of the outreach granted anonymity to speak about private details. Gruters has not yet taken Vance up on his offer, the person said.
Vance’s office did not respond to a request for comment.

“There is an element that is concerned about this underlying President Trump support, and if we don’t vote for his guy, we’re undermining the president and further giving him more bad news, black eyes, and there’s some sensitivities to that,” said a second RNC member who is undecided about the leadership election and granted anonymity to speak candidly about sensitive political dynamics.
“But you also have some that are more protective of the brand and the party than they are to the person, especially given the results of this last election cycle,” the person said.
Trump allies have been checking in with RNC members to gauge where they stand in the leadership race, said the RNC member, who received such a call.
body_zh: 共和党全国委员会主席正忙于避免成为该党中期选举的替罪羊。
在唐纳德·特朗普总统的支持下，乔·格鲁特斯通常会保住共和党全国委员会主席的职位。但在本月的中期选举惨败之后，他现在正试图在 1 月份领导人选举之前抵御来自联合主席 KC Crosbie 的新贵和令人惊讶的强大挑战。随着两位候选人在幕后争取支持，成员之间在谁应对本月初的这场惨败以及接下来会发生什么问题上出现了深刻的分歧。
政党领导人一直不愿公开指责特朗普及其不受欢​​迎的议程。相反，与熟悉委员会动态的两打共和党全国委员会成员和工作人员的对话显示，一些人正在将他们的沮丧情绪发泄到格鲁特斯身上。尽管他的支持者认为他因困难的政治环境而受到不公平的指责，但格鲁特斯仍然可能成为替罪羊。
对于格鲁特斯的一些批评者来说，决定很简单：必须有人为曾经难以想象的损失付出代价。
“现在是新领导层的时候了。这根本不反对乔，”肯塔基州共和党主席罗伯特·本韦努蒂说，他计划投票给克罗斯比。 “但不同的时代需要不同的领导力、不同类型的领导者。”
一位尚未做出决定的共和党全国委员会成员补充道：“人们非常愤怒。”这名不愿透露姓名的成员坦率地谈论了私人谈话，他描述了成员们质疑是否“对那个被正确或错误地视为这场混乱的始作俑者的人盖上橡皮图章”的问题。
共和党全国委员会内部的辩论——是与特朗普支持的候选人决裂还是坚持现状——反映出共和党正在就如何与总统保持一致进行更广泛的思考。许多共和党人已经接受特朗普在未来两年继续占据主导地位，但一些共和党全国委员会成员已经开始以其他方式鼓动变革，包括呼吁对中期选举进行尸检并推迟国会领导人选举。
几名共和党全国委员会成员表示，格鲁特斯帮助委员会在本周期筹集了数百万美元，并认为这本身就是他工作的关键部分，而且他处理得很好。其他人则对共和党全国委员会没有更早地在他们的州参与或花钱感到沮丧。一些成员批评格鲁特斯允许共和党全国委员会过度卷入白宫的政治运作。
西弗吉尼亚州共和党主席乔什·霍尔斯坦（Josh Holstein）表示，“该党筹集了很多钱，我们也花掉了。我不认为有那么多钱可以放在（格鲁特斯）脚下。”他表示，他还没有在领导竞选中做出任何承诺。 “与此同时，我知道委员会中有很多成员认为我们需要走不同的方向，共和党全国委员会在决策方面需要更加自主。”
共和党全国委员会和克罗斯比拒绝置评。白宫没有回应置评请求。
格鲁特斯竞选团队在一份声明中表示，共和党全国委员会成员“团结在格鲁特斯主席身后，因为他们知道他永远不会停止为共和党而战。”
竞选团队表示：“主席乔·格鲁特斯在共和党各个层面拥有 25 年的经验，打破了筹款记录，建立了党内历史上最大的选举诚信行动，并推进了特朗普总统的议程。”
领导人竞选的结果将通过无记名投票决定，这将考验共和党全国委员会成员愿意在多大程度上改变路线——即使这意味着反抗特朗普。赌注是巨大的，共和党全国委员会在总统竞选中发挥着关键作用，包括主持共和党初选辩论、主办该党 2028 年代表大会以及支持最终提名人。
特朗普本人的参与让计算变得更加复杂：据两位不愿透露姓名的知情人士透露，特朗普一直是格鲁特斯的直言不讳的支持者，并私下表示，如果克罗斯比赢得领导权之争，他不会在 2028 年之前协助共和党全国委员会筹款。该威胁最先由 Axios 报告。
这显然承认，就连特朗普也知道这是一场真正的竞争，而且他选择的候选人可能会成为替罪羊。
据一位不愿透露姓名的知情人士透露，副总统 JD 万斯 (JD Vance) 还担任共和党全国委员会的财务主席，正在考虑竞选总统，他私下表示愿意协助格鲁特斯的连任竞选。该人士称，格鲁特斯尚未接受万斯的提议。
万斯的办公室没有回应置评请求。
另一位共和党全国委员会成员表示：“有一个因素担心特朗普总统的潜在支持，如果我们不投票给他的人，我们就会削弱总统的地位，并进一步给他带来更多坏消息，这会带来一些敏感性。”另一位共和党全国委员会成员对领导人选举尚未做出决定，并要求匿名坦诚地谈论敏感的政治动态。
“但也有一些人对品牌和政党的保护程度高于对个人的保护程度，特别是考虑到上一个选举周期的结果，”该人士表示。
接到电话的共和党全国委员会成员表示，特朗普的盟友一直在与共和党全国委员会成员核实，以了解他们在领导竞选中的立场。

title_en: 10 Best Meal Delivery Services, Tested by an Ex-Restaurant Critic
title_zh: 由前餐厅评论家测试的 10 种最佳送餐服务
summary: Here are the best delivery services and meal kits in 2026, including the Martha Stewart meal service, a GLP-1–supportive plan, and a budget-friendly option.
summary_zh: 以下是 2026 年最好的送货服务和餐包，包括 Martha Stewart 餐食服务、GLP-1 支持计划以及经济实惠的套餐
body_en: The best meal delivery services and meal kits are the ones that make your home life easier—and maybe make dinner something to look forward to rather than to dread. I didn't actually expect to appreciate meal kits as much as I do, as someone who likes to cook and worked as a food critic on both coasts for more than a decade.

I've found that the best meal kits helped me climb out of a cooking rut of turning to the same dishes—and the same flavors—over and over. After testing every major meal delivery service over the past two years, I've narrowed the field to just a few of the best options for each family and diet. Quite simply, the best meals I've eaten from a meal kit have come from Marley Spoon , which offers a path to genuinely good home-cooked meals on nights when I might otherwise feel uninspired.

But depending on your priorities, other meal delivery services might be the best for you. I've found that Home Chef offers the greatest flexibility for busy families while keeping prices affordable. EveryPlate is the best meal kit for people on a tight budget. For a healthful, tailored diet (including an option on true gluten-free meals), I recommend Green Chef . If you'd rather not cook at all, CookUnity is the best prepared-meal delivery service I've ever had the pleasure to warm up.

I assessed each meal plan's recipes, breadth of selection, sourcing, ease of preparation, convenience, organization, packaging, high-quality ingredients, and suitability for different eating restrictions and needs. I also tested the best new and innovative meal kits for those looking for alternatives to Blue Apron or HelloFresh's long-standing meal delivery services. And not for nothing, I sorted out some often maddeningly nontransparent pricing. Here are the best delivery meal subscriptions I've tried.

Be sure to check out my investigation into whether sometimes Meal Kits Are Cheaper Than Groceries when trying out new recipes, and WIRED's related guides, including the Best Plant-Based Meal Kits , Best Food Gifts You Can Buy Online , Best Coffee Subscriptions , and Best Delivery Chocolate Boxes .

Updated September 2026: After a new round of testing, I've listed Green Chef as my favorite meal kit for clean ingredients and dietary restrictions. I also retested CookUnity and confirmed its place as the best prepared meal delivery service. I likewise retested and updated my descriptions of Factor prepared meals and GardenCup’s salad kit, and added information about HelloFresh’s new recipe app and Blue Apron’s new packaging and partnership with Misfits Market.

In the decade since it was introduced on American shores, the strength of the Martha Stewart–endorsed Marley Spoon meal delivery service has remained steadfast: It's the cooking.

但根据您的优先事项，其他送餐服务可能最适合您。我发现 Home Chef 为忙碌的家庭提供了最大的灵活性，同时保持价格实惠。 EveryPlate 是适合预算紧张的人的最佳餐盒。对于健康、量身定制的饮食（包括真正的无麸质膳食的选择），我推荐 Green Chef。如果您根本不想做饭，CookUnity 是我有幸热身过的最好的预制餐食配送服务。
